jobs.title: Director, Value Engineering (DACH) - CPG/Retail
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**About Celonis**
-----------------



Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes.



The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise\-ready.



Industry\-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.


**About the Role**
------------------



Based at our global headquarters in **Munich**, as a **Value Engineering Manager / Director** for **CPG \& Retail**, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the **CPG \& Retail segment across the DACH region**. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high\-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI\-driven product execution, driving the end\-to\-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.



In this role, you will serve as a player\-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high\-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top\-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C\-level executives at major enterprise accounts.


**What Sets Our Patch Apart**
-----------------------------



The DACH CPG \& Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators.



As our DACH CPG \& Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C\-level decision\-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* **Drive Business Outcomes \& Account Growth:** Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG \& Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
* **People Leadership \& Coaching:** Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich\-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
* **Executive Advisory \& Player\-Coach:** Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high\-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
* **Enterprise AI Champion:** Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next\-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
* **Ecosystem \& Partner Strategy:** Cultivate executive\-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
* **Thought Leadership:** Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry\-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.

**Leadership Behaviors We Value**
---------------------------------


* **Deliver Business Outcomes:** Focus on top\- and bottom\-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
* **Motivate, Develop \& Nurture Talent:** Build an inclusive, high\-trust environment that attracts top\-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
* **Lead by Example:** Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on\-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
* **Think BIG, Be BOLD:** Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go\-to\-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.

**Qualifications \& Scope**
---------------------------


* **Language Skills:** Native or business\-fluent **German** (spoken and written) and fluent **English** are required to interface effectively with executive decision\-makers across the DACH market.
* **Location Presence:** Based in or willing to relocate to **Munich**, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
* **Proven Leadership Experience:** Track record leading pre\-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG \& Retail industries.
* **People Management:** Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high\-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
* **Executive Presence:** Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C\-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.

  

  

**What Celonis can offer you:**


* **Pioneer Innovation:** Work with the leading, award\-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* **Accelerate Your Growth:** Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Receive Exceptional Benefits:** Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.
* **Prioritize Your Well\-being:** Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well\-being programs.
* **Connect and Belong:** Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
* **Make Meaningful Impact:** Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
* **Collaborate Globally:** Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* **Empowered Environment:** Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

  

  

**About Us:**  

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry\-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It's system\-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

jobs.title: Internship - Equipment Integration & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
The student will join the Equipment Integration \& Automation team and work under the guidance of a dedicated mentor for a period of 5–6 months. During the internship, the student will gain hands\-on experience and contribute to the development of an automated equipment software deployment solution, with the objective of improving deployment efficiency, consistency, and reliability. The internship will provide the student with practical exposure to programming, automation, software testing, troubleshooting, and equipment integration, enabling the application of theoretical knowledge to real\-world manufacturing and engineering challenges. The student will also collaborate with experienced engineers and cross\-functional teams, gaining valuable industry exposure and developing a deeper understanding of equipment automation, software integration, and semiconductor manufacturing environments.

  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

* **Tester Integration (TEC):** Learn the fundamentals of tester and equipment integration and understand how TEC supports equipment operation within the manufacturing environment.
* **Automation Application Development:** Develop an application to automate TEC software deployment, improving deployment efficiency and reducing manual activities.
* **Software Testing \& Validation:** Conduct testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure the developed solution is reliable and suitable for production use.
* **Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing:** Prepare technical documentation, user guidelines, and share the developed solution with the team to support future implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement.

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

* **Education:** Currently studying in a Bachelor’s degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, preferably in the 3rd or 4th year of study.
* **Programming \& Technical Skills:** Basic programming knowledge in languages such as Python, C\#, C/C\+\+, or similar, with a strong interest in software development, automation, and equipment integration.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex technical issues and develop practical, effective solutions.
* **Advantageous Skills:** Basic knowledge of software deployment, networking, databases, version control systems like Git, or manufacturing automation would be an added advantage.

jobs.description:
**About the role** **Job Title**: Site Engineer


**Location:** Aberdeen


**Project Type:** Civils / Energy


**Company:** Balfour Beatty Group



Balfour Beatty is a leading national infrastructure and construction company with more than a century of heritage in Scotland, delivering key projects that strengthen communities and improve national connectivity.



The Netherton Hub is a major new energy infrastructure development located near Peterhead in Aberdeenshire, forming a key part of SSEN Transmission’s multi‑billion‑pound **Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment (ASTI)** programme and its wider **Pathway to 2030** upgrade of the Scottish transmission network.



Designed to strengthen the UK’s ability to transport renewable electricity from the north of Scotland to high‑demand centres nationwide, the hub will incorporate a new High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) converter station, a 400 kV substation, a 132 kV substation, and associated operational facilities. Once complete, it will enable efficient long‑distance transmission of offshore and onshore renewable energy, supporting both UK and Scottish Government net‑zero targets while delivering significant economic benefits, job creation, and local supply‑chain opportunities.



By joining the ASTI Netherton Hub project, candidates will gain hands‑on experience delivering one of the UK’s most significant energy programmes, developing advanced personal and professional skills, benefiting from long‑term career progression within a national framework, and playing a direct role in strengthening Scotland’s renewable‑powered future

 **What you'll be doing**  


* Ensure all works are delivered safely and in accordance with Balfour Beatty and SSEN health, safety and environmental requirements.
* Manage and supervise day\-to\-day site activities across earthworks, drainage, roads, ducting, foundations and utility installations.
* Set out works accurately in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and project tolerances.
* Conduct site surveys and maintain survey control points throughout construction.
* Review construction drawings and technical information, identifying and resolving engineering issues before works commence.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer (Main Plant)
jobs.description:
**Senior Design Engineer (Main Plant)**

**Cambuslang**

**Salary from £55,000 to £68,750**

**Permanent/Hybrid**

  

**Closing Date: 06/10/2026**

  

**Help us create a better future, quicker!**

  

At SP Energy Networks our focus is on harnessing technology and innovation to create the networks of the future. Our team is building a dynamic network to meet the changing demands for electricity and increasingly, renewable electricity – safely, securely and sustainably in the communities we serve.

  

At SP Energy Networks, we know people are central to building a better future, quicker and we are seeking new talent to join our team.

  

**What you’ll be doing**

  

Develop and deliver Main Plant engineering solutions for transmission networks (132kV and above), producing engineering specifications, designs and technical support throughout the project lifecycle. The role includes design calculations, reports, drawings, standards development and technical expertise for Main Plant equipment installations across ScottishPower Transmission projects.

  

* Develop Main Plant and auxiliary equipment requirements for project specifications, authorisations and construction programmes.
* Produce engineering designs and specifications for switchgear, transformers and other primary plant equipment.
* Review tender submissions, assess technical compliance and approve design drawings and documentation.
* Ensure designs meet current legislation, operational requirements and industry standards.
* Provide technical guidance during design, construction and commissioning, resolving complex site issues.
* Prepare engineering documentation and deliverables in line with project quality requirements.
* Champion health, safety, environmental and quality standards across all activities.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated engineering solutions.
* Support technical training and knowledge sharing for new technologies and equipment.
  

**What You'll Bring**

  

* Degree in Engineering, or HND with relevant industry experience.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Knowledge of CDM regulations and health \& safety best practice within a design environment.
* Understanding of transmission substation plant and associated equipment.
* Experience of electrical infrastructure projects and transmission or distribution networks.
* Knowledge of one or more of the following: Switchgear, Transformers, Transmission Systems or Distribution Network Design (33kV to 400kV).
  

**Minimum Criteria**

  

* Engineering Degree or HND with relevant experience.
* Experience in electrical substation design for infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of transmission and/or distribution network plant and equipment.
* Full UK driving licence.
  

**What’s in it for you**

  

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

  

  

At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family’s wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action – our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world – today and tomorrow. That’s why our benefits include:

  

  

* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Share Incentive Plan and Sharesave Scheme

jobs.title: Navigation Solution Architect, EMEA
jobs.description:
Advanced Navigation is the world’s most determined innovator in AI robotics and navigation technologies across land, air, sea and space applications. Founded on a culture of research and discovery, Advanced Navigation's mission is to be the catalyst of the autonomy revolution. Fields of expertise include artificial intelligence, underwater sonar, GNSS, radio frequency systems, inertial sensors, robotics, quantum sensors and photonics.
Today, Advanced Navigation is a supplier to some of the world's largest companies, including Airbus, Boeing, Google, Tesla, NASA, Apple, and General Motors. Discover it for yourself: https://youtu.be/F7uAqs1gtuk  

As Navigation Solutions Architect – EMEA, you will be responsible for designing technical solutions for Advanced Navigation's key EMEA customers, utilising the full Advanced Navigation product and configuration portfolio. This role is remote\-based within EMEA and will require significant travel (in excess of 30%) to customer sites, clustered around key deliverables.  

In this key technical role, you will work closely with some of Advanced Navigation's largest and most strategic EMEA customer accounts, with a portfolio weighted approximately 80% Defence (UK, NATO and wider European markets) and 20% Commercial. You will provide strategic advice internally and externally, assisting with product design and configuration, and bridging the relationship between the customer and Advanced Navigation's Product and Engineering teams.  

Success in this position will be measured by technically qualified opportunity development and XL deal capture resulting from fit\-for\-purpose technical solution designs and the quality of the customer relationships you develop. Your role will be crucial in facilitating technical discovery and mapping the right Advanced Navigation solutions to meet customer needs. Although an individual contributor role, you will provide the technical direction for the EMEA Forward Deployed Engineers in a matrix relationship with the Sales Operations Manager – EMEA (who retains commercial and operational line management of that team), as well as offering technical mentorship to the wider Application Engineering team and critical insight to inform the product roadmap of the global Navigation Solutions Team. **ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES*** **Solution architecture validation and design:**
* Deeply understand customer requirements
* Translate high\-level client performance requirements into architectural navigation system designs and hardware/software configurations
* Lead the design and architectural validation of Advanced Navigation product configurations tailored to specific client mission profiles
* Lead the design and execution of proof of concept projects to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of proposed solutions
* Serve as the primary technical authority for EMEA sales teams, providing strategic advice on complex system integration
* Collaborate closely with counterparts from key accounts to provide consultation in relation to systems integration and performance optimisation
* Provide technical direction to the Forward Deployed Engineers, in a matrix relationship with the Sales Operations Manager – EMEA, who retains commercial and operational line management of that team
* **Technical leadership and expertise:**
* Maintain an expert\-level understanding of the entire Advanced Navigation product ecosystem, including inertial sensors (MEMS \& FOG), GNSS technologies and other peripheral sensors, including Laser and Acoustic Velocity systems
* Apply deeply technical engineering acumen to troubleshoot and optimise system performance for extreme environments (e.g., subsea, aerospace, or autonomous defence platforms)
* Conduct technical workshops and deep\-dive sessions for Tier\-0 clients to demonstrate the value proposition of proposed architectures
* **Market and domain alignment:**
* Anticipate and interpret evolving navigation requirements within UK, NATO and wider European Defence and Commercial markets
* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to maintain a deep understanding of our products and their positioning in the EMEA market
* Collaborate with the global Navigation Solutions Team to feed regional market requirements back into the product development lifecycle
* Foster strong relationships with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Customer Success
* Growth:
* Growing \& developing with the Company as Advanced Navigation continues to evolve;
* Taking on additional duties \& tasks, as directed, as the position evolves.
* Develop a solid operational understanding of all aspects within the Company:
* Immersing yourself into the team \& wider organisation to develop an understanding of how each role \& team all contribute to our strategic vision.
* Live by our values:
* Set quantifiable targets that demonstrate your commitment to our values.
* Safety:
* + Live \& breathe a safety culture;
	+ Be an advocate for safety within the workplace;
	+ Remain compliant with all HSE requirements \& obligations.

 **KEY MEASURABLES*** Technically qualified pipeline development: Generation of high\-value, technically qualified opportunities in target applications and accounts
* Win Rate / Capture: Percentage and value of converted opportunities to closed\-won
* Client Satisfaction (NPS): Post\-deployment Net Promoter Scores reflecting the technical efficacy and reliability of the designed solutions
* Standard solution delivery: Optimising for the utilisation of the off\-the\-shelf Advanced Navigation products and configurations

 **KEY RELATIONSHIPS*** Managing Director, EMEA
* Sales Director, EMEA
* Sales Operations Manager, EMEA (matrix relationship – commercial and operational line management of Forward Deployed Engineers)
* Forward Deployed Engineers (technical direction, matrix)
* Global Navigation Solutions Team
* Product and Engineering teams
* Global Marketing
* Customer Success

 **BEHAVIOURAL ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS*** **Organising Self**
* + *Manages own tasks and processes within projects, working independently under general direction. Independently determines and develops approach to solutions. Work is reviewed upon completion for soundness of technical judgement and adequacy in meeting objectives*
* **Maintaining Positive Energy**
* + *Being relentless. Operating with a positive attitude, vigour and determination in the face of challenging situations, consistently maintaining high levels of effectiveness and productivity throughout*
* **Delivering Excellence**
* + *Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self\-imposing standards and expectations of excellence rather than having standards imposed*
* **Communication**
* + *Conducting positive and open interactions with others by conveying information and ideas clearly and concisely in an engaging manner that helps them understand and retain the message; listening actively to others and sharing proactively information*
* **Decision Making**
* + *Identifying and understanding problems and opportunities relevant to role by gathering and analysing quantitative and qualitative information; generating and evaluating alternatives, identifying the best course of action, and making timely decisions within own decision making scope*
* **Initiating Action**
* + *Taking proactive and independent action to accomplish work goals; taking prompt action to achieve results beyond what is required; anticipating addresses problems without being prompted*
* **Leveraging Feedback**
* + *Taking full advantage of opportunities to receive and explore feedback about own performance; responding favourably to feedback and using it constructively to deliver outcomes and improve knowledge, skills and behaviours*

 **QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** **Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Master's preferred) or 10\+ years of relevant experience
* No security clearance required at the point of hire; the successful candidate may be required to apply for UK/European security clearance (e.g. SC) at a later date, depending on programme requirements

 **Experience:*** Proven depth of experience and seniority spanning multiple engineering and commercial disciplines: Sales, Mechatronics, Software Engineering (SWE), Electrical Engineering (EE), and Mechanical Engineering (MechE)
* Solid technical knowledge of inertial navigation systems, GNSS, and fibre optic gyroscopes, Laser and Acoustic Velocity aiding
* High level of familiarity with UK and European export control regimes (e.g. UK Export Control Joint Unit (ECJU) licensing, Open General Export Licences (OGELs), and the EU Dual\-Use Regulation); working knowledge of U.S. ITAR/EAR requirements beneficial where solutions incorporate U.S.\-origin technology
* Willingness to take on an outsized portion of Defence programmes and accept that the role may involve travel in excess of 30%

* Experience in configuration and data management on and off premises in multinational matrixed organisations

* Customer\-facing role, with a balanced capability across pre\-sales, implementation, and support functions
* A dedication to delivering a great customer experience while being a creative problem\-solver in response to technical, product, and business questions
* Experience working with Python for data analysis
* Enjoyment in being in a fast\-paced environment, to help customers accelerate their journey to creating an accurate position, velocity, acceleration and orientation under the most demanding conditions
* A collaborative and team\-oriented mindset for accomplishing goals

 **Skills:*** Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent time management, driven to work quickly
* Strong attention to detail
* Effective presentation crafting and delivery skills
* Coding experience is a plus

### **Job summary**


The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.


The agency is made up of c.1700 staff working across two main centres and peripatetically across the UK and abroad.


The agency consists of Corporate, Partnerships, Transformation, Governance, Communications \& Engagement, Scientific Research \& Innovation, Healthcare Quality \& Access, Safety \& Surveillance and Technology groups.  



  

**About the Division**


This post is based in the Software and AI team, which is part of the Innovation and Compliance Group.


The group is responsible for taking all reasonable steps to protect public health and safeguard the interests of patients by ensuring that software and AI as a medical device meet all appropriate standards of safety and performance and to encourage safe use.


The Group provides technical, policy and regulatory leadership on software and AI\-enabled medical devices through a range of safety, regulatory, policy and technical activities. This includes:

* Review of clinical investigations.
* Review of applications for exceptional use.
* Undertaking technical file reviews to underpin compliance activity.
* Engaging with internal and external stakeholders on issues involving software and AI\-enabled medical devices.
* Developing innovative policy and programmes.
* Working with international partners.
* Undertaking activities to identify safety signals for further investigation.


In response to the Secretary of States desire to progress commitments in the 10 Year Health Plan, the MHRA established an expert, non\-statutory National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare to inform the development of a new regulatory framework for AI in healthcare and provide recommendations in 2026\.


The National Commission is providing recommendations to the MHRA and the broader healthcare system to ensure patients in Great Britain have fast access to safe and effective AI devices. The MHRA will implement these recommendations through the design of an updated framework for AI Medical Devices and by driving policy and programme change for software and AI\-enabled medical devices.

### **Job description**


The postholder will be responsible for the following:

* lead and contribute to policy development on software and AI\-enabled medical devices,
* lead technical reviews and enquiries on software and AI\-enabled medical devices,
* lead and support the international and domestic programmes of work on AI and software enabled medical device.


The postholders will play a pivotal role in helping to shape the UKs approach to AI governance in healthcare, ensuring that regulatory frameworks are evidence\-based, future\-proof, and aligned with public interest

**Key responsibilities and results areas**

**Leadership and Management**

* Lead part of the policy function within the AI and Software Policy Team. This may include: lead technical reviews and enquiries on software and AI\-enabled medical devices or lead the international programme of work on AI and software as a medical device.
* Take responsibility for delivering discrete projects or work packages within the regulation of AI in healthcare, meeting defined objectives under tight deadlines and reporting progress, decisions and risks to senior colleagues.
* Be proactive and independent whilst also being a strong team player, working purposefully towards achieving programme goals.
* Line manage 1\-2 or more advisors.

**Service Delivery**

* Assess and develop policy responses to the risks and regulatory challenges associated with advanced AI technologies, such as foundation models and generative AI, drawing on sound judgement, problem\-solving skills and an understanding of the wider political, economic and technological context in the UK and internationally.
* Provide regulatory advice and guidance on the implementation and interpretation of the current and future software and AI\-enabled medical devices regulatory framework, applying experience in policy, regulation, technology, law and/or AI governance.
* Gather, synthesise and evaluate complex evidence from technical, legal, operational and socio\-economic perspectives to inform the development of primary and secondary legislation on software and AI\-enabled medical devices regulation.
* Produce clear, accurate and persuasive policy products, including reports, briefings, consultation responses, regulatory guidance and best practice materials, tailored to a range of audiences.
* Represent the MHRA at working\-level meetings, workshops and conferences, presenting MHRA positions clearly, professionally and with sensitivity to high\-profile policy and regulatory issues.

**Service Improvement**

* Engage, negotiate and maintain effective relationships with industry, civil society, academia, government, other regulators and senior officials to inform the MHRAs work and communicate policy positions.
* Work closely with colleagues across the Software and AI team, Innovation and Compliance Group and wider Agency to ensure joined\-up delivery of AI and Software as a medical device regulation projects.
* Forge productive relationships with external parties to support successful programme delivery.

**Quality and Assurance**

* Gather, analyse and evaluate complex evidence to support robust regulatory and policy decisions.
* Ensure policy products, guidance and advice are clear, accurate and evidence based.

**General**

* Deliver difficult or complex messages with decisiveness, clarity and sensitivity, being persuasive when required.
* Promote diversity, inclusion and equality of opportunity, respecting difference and external experience.
* Demonstrate commitment to continuous self\-learning, development, innovation and challenge.
* Be proactive and independent in managing work whilst contributing effectively as part of a wider team.


The job description is not intended to be exhaustive and it is likely that duties may be altered from time to time in the light of changing circumstances and after consultation with the postholder.

* lead a portfolio of the international or domestic programme of work on AI and software enabled medical device,


The postholders will play a pivotal role in helping to shape the UKs approach to AI governance in healthcare, ensuring that regulatory frameworks are evidence\-based, future\-proof, and aligned with public interest.

### **Person specification**

jobs.title: Industrial Placement - Electrical Engineer ( Power Systems Analysis & HV Engineering)
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineering
UKIMEA Region

BIR0000SJ Requisition \#  


**Industrial Placement \- Electrical Engineer ( Power Systems Analysis \& HV Engineering)**

 **See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup**

 **See it differently**

  

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.  

 Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.  

 Our team of Electrical Engineers apply their specialist skills to infrastructure projects across the UK and worldwide. We work with clients from a wide range of industries including but not limited to:

  

* Electricity network owners such as National Grid, Scottish and Southern Energy Networks
  
* Energy developers – Offshore and onshore wind, HVDC interconnectors, hydro, solar PV, hydrogen, BESS, waste\-to\-energy
  
* Industrial Clients – Data centres, Industrial/Commercial parks
  
* Energy Investors – Seeking to understand the impact of technical risks on a potential investment
  
* We are driven by producing technically excellent, innovative and sustainable solutions for our clients.

  

 The opportunity

  

On this 10–12\-month Internship you will be aligned to and working with our Power Systems \& HV Engineers:

  

We are seeking enthusiastic early career professionals with an interest in power systems analysis and high voltage electrical design to work with us. This will give you the opportunity to be at the heart of the energy transition, working on power system analysis, design and research that will help to deliver a more secure, sustainable and resilient electricity network in the face of increasing complexity.

  

You will contribute to power systems analysis and design supporting some of the most significant developments in the energy sector, including offshore wind integration, battery energy storage systems, large HVDC transmission projects, industrial electrification schemes and future net\-zero infrastructure.

  

Under the mentorship of our senior engineers, you will have the opportunity to work on several different projects, some of which may be external client\-facing and some of which may be internal research and development projects. Due to the multi\-disciplinary nature of our projects and delivery teams, you may work alongside a wide range of experts. The role will enable you to deepen not only technical skills but also communication and management skills.

  

You'll join an unrivalled, inclusive community of experts, where everyone is encouraged to develop their career path and skillset, working with team members to deliver an effective and professional service to our clients.

  

Is this role right for you?

  

For this opportunity, we are seeking undergraduate students who:

  

* Are working towards a Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. Study towards a Masters in Electrical Engineering, General Engineering, Engineering Science, Power Systems Engineering, Energy Engineering, or Communications Engineering would be advantageous.
  
* Are studying an IET\-accredited degree programme, or a course that supports progression towards professional registration
  
* Demonstrate an interest in power systems engineering and an understanding of topics such as electrical networks, power transmission and distribution, renewable energy, protection and control, or power system modelling gained through academic studies
  
* Some experience with coding languages would be an advantage
  
* Possess a strong working knowledge of MS Office
  
* Demonstrate enthusiasm for a career in electrical engineering, underpinned by a knowledge and understanding of our sector and work
  
* Have an analytical thought process and ability to innovate and think broadly
  
* Possess an aptitude to work on their own initiative and be proactive

  

 Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;

  

* Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
  
* Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
  
* Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
  
* Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

  

 What we offer you

  

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.  

 Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.  

 We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.  

 We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.

  

Next steps  

 We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.  

 The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.

  

Different people, shared values

  

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence.  

 Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup.

  

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.  

 As a Disability Confident Level 2 Employer in the UK, we will strive for one third of all our interview places to be allocated to candidates who have disclosed they are disability confident and best meet the requirements of the role.

**Company Description**  

Do you want to develop your career and make an impact in the fast\-growth, fast\-moving B2B technology space?


At Informa TechTarget, you’ll collaborate and grow alongside some of the industry’s most respected experts. You’ll work with leading brands and be exposed to world\-shaping innovations. You’ll apply your energy and intellect to helping clients be faster to market and faster to revenue.


We’re a vibrant community of world\-class practitioners – over 2000 colleagues strong – with offices in 19 locations around the world. We’re traded on Nasdaq and also part of Informa PLC, a global leader in business\-to\-business events, digital services, and academic research in the FTSE 100\.

**About Informa TechTarget**

**Informa TechTarget (Nasdaq: TTGT) informs, influences and connects the world’s technology buyers and sellers, to accelerate growth from R\&D to ROI.**


With an unparalleled reach of over 220 highly targeted technology\-specific websites and more than 50 million permissioned first\-party audience members, Informa TechTarget has a unique understanding of and insight into technology markets.


Underpinned by those audiences and their data, we offer expert\-led, data\-driven, and digitally enabled services that deliver significant impact and measurable outcomes to our clients. We provide our customers with:

* Trusted information that shapes the industry and informs investment
* Intelligence and advice that guides and influences strategy
* Advertising that grows reputation and establishes thought leadership
* Custom content that engages and prompts action
* Intent and demand generation that more precisely targets and converts


Our organization is committed to sustainability, diversity, wellbeing, and ethical working practices. Visit informatechtarget.com and follow us on LinkedIn.


For more information, visit informatechtarget.com and follow us on LinkedIn

 **Job Description** **This role is based in our 240 Blackfriars, London office.**


We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve our Windows\-based infrastructure running in AWS. This role is focused on operational excellence, security, automation, and developer enablement.


You’ll work closely with product engineering teams to ensure systems are secure, reliable, and easy to deploy, while driving improvements in CI/CD, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage and operate Windows Server environments in AWS (EC2\), ensuring high availability and performance
* Own patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening processes across Windows workloads
* Monitor and respond to security events, working closely with security teams to remediate risks
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support consistent, reliable application deployments
* Implement and improve Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or similar tools
* Develop automation using PowerShell and scripting to reduce manual operational overhead
* Design and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to ensure system health
* Partner with product engineering teams to troubleshoot application and infrastructure issues
* Support releases and ensure smooth deployment processes across environments
* Participate in on\-call rotations and act as an escalation point for production incidents
* Lead or contribute to incident response and post\-mortems, driving long\-term improvements

**Core Tech Stack**

*AWS (Primary)*

* EC2 (Windows workloads), VPC, IAM
* S3, EBS, Systems Manager (SSM)
* CloudWatch (or integration with tools like Datadog)
* Load Balancers (ALB/NLB)

*Infrastructure \& Automation*

* Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation
* CI/CD: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar

*Microsoft / Windows*

* Windows Server administration
* MS SQL Server (standalone and AWS RDS)
* Active Directory / identity integration
* IIS and .NET application hosting
* PowerShell scripting and automation

*Observability \& Operations*

* Monitoring and alerting platforms (Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.)
* Logging and incident response tooling

  

**Qualifications** **What We’re Looking For**

* Extensive experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Engineering
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS in production environments
* Proven experience managing Windows Server infrastructure (preferably in AWS)
* Experience with patching, vulnerability remediation, and security event handling
* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform strongly preferred)
* Strong scripting skills in PowerShell
* Experience with monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting production systems
* Ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams and support production workloads

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Active Directory integration in AWS (Managed AD, AD Connector)
* Familiarity with Sitecore CMS, other .NET applications and IIS in production
* Experience with AWS Systems Manager (SSM) for patching and automation
* Exposure to containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Experience with Datadog or OpenTelemetry\-based observability
* Understanding of FinOps and cloud cost optimisation

**What Makes You Successful**

* You prioritise automation, reliability, and repeatability in everything you build
* You take ownership of systems and drive issues through resolution
* You’re comfortable working in production environments and handling incidents
* You collaborate effectively with engineering and security teams
* You continuously look for ways to reduce toil and improve system stability

  

**Additional Information**  

We believe that great things happen when people connect face\-to\-face. That's why we work in\-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.


TechTarget, Inc., doing business as Informa TechTarget, including its subsidiaries is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, training, promotion, discipline, compensation, benefits, and termination of employment. If you would like to request reasonable adjustments or accommodations to assist your participation in the hiring process and, or in the advertised position, please inform the appropriate Talent Acquisition Partner for the role once they have been in touch. Your request will be reviewed and considered in confidence.


Informa TechTarget complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable federal, state or local law.

**Our benefits include:**

* **Great community:** a welcoming culture with in\-person and online social events, our fantastic Walk the World charity day and active diversity and inclusion networks
* **Broader impact:** take up to four days per year to volunteer, with charity match funding available too
* **Career opportunity:** the opportunity to develop your career with bespoke training and learning, mentoring platforms and on\-demand access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning. When it’s time for the next step, we encourage and support internal job moves
* **Time out:** annual leave, birthday leave and the chance to work from (almost!) anywhere for up to four weeks a year
* A flexible range of personal benefits to choose from, plus company funded private medical cover
* A ShareMatch scheme that allows you to become an Informa shareholder with free matching shares
* Strong wellbeing support through EAP assistance, mental health first aiders, a healthy living subsidy, access to health apps and more
* Recognition for great work, with global awards and kudos programmes
* As an international company, the chance to collaborate with teams around the world

jobs.title: Automation Test Engineer - SC Eligible
jobs.description:
**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------


We work closely with clients and partners to take full advantage of the opportunities of technology. We mobilize expert teams that create custom solutions from existing and emerging technology to deliver viable outcomes at speed. We call this 'Value in the making.'
  

Part of the Capgemini Group, Sogeti makes business value through technology for organizations that need to implement innovation at speed and want a local partner with global scale. With a hands\-on culture and close proximity to its clients, Sogeti is currently looking for a Automation Test Engineer to join our Quality Engineering and Test Practice, ensuring alignment with business goals and driving impactful value creation for our clients.


*Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.*


*If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre\-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)*


**Your role**
-------------


**Essential Skills:**
---------------------


* Experience in creating effective automation test strategies and plans.
* Experience in test automation using at least two proprietary or OpenSource tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or Tricentis Tosca
* Experience creating or adapting automation frameworks
* Familiarity with at least one OOP language (Java, Python, C\# etc.)
* Creating test scripts within a BDD environment using Cucumber, SpecFlow or similar
* Ability to manage and maintain versions of test assets in GIT and other repositories
* Experience of working in Agile / DevOps environments
* Hands on experience of various test types (manual and automation) such as Functional, API, web and mobility
* Experience with CI / CD Pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar, and integrating automation assets into the pipeline
* Experience of managing a small team of test engineers
* Ability to collaborate with developers, testers, analysts, architects, and other members across the organisation.
  

ISTQB or equivalent certification in testing at foundation level or above (or willingness to obtain an ISTQB Foundation, soon after joining us, which we will cover the cost of the exam)

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.


**Mandatory Skills :**
----------------------


* OOP language such as Java, Python, C\#
* Functional Test tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Tricentis Tosca
* Test management tools such as Jira, TFS, OpenText ALM
* Experience of working in waterfall, agile and DevOps environments
* Other tooling such as Postman. Ready API, Soap UI
* Data masking and data subsetting
* BDD approaches using tooling such as Cucumber or SpecFlow
**Your security clearance**
---------------------------


To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
  

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
  

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
  

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


**We are a Disability Confident Employer:**
-------------------------------------------


Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


* Declare they have a disability, and
* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.


**What does 'Get The Future You Want' mean for you?**
-----------------------------------------------------


You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Management or, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  

You will be encouraged to have a positive work\-life balance. Our hybrid\-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day\-to\-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.


**Why you should consider Capgemini:**
--------------------------------------


Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.


**About Capgemini:**
--------------------


Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.

jobs.title: Integration Developer - Azure
jobs.description:
We’re building thriving communities as one of the UK’s largest housing groups and a leading developer of affordable housing.


We believe everyone is entitled to a good home they can afford, in a place they are proud to live. More than 100,000 people live in our homes.


If you want to experience work that’s truly rewarding, join us. Because when we achieve together, customers and communities thrive.


Work for Orbit. Believe in people.

**The role**


Orbit is delighted to be recruiting for an Integration Developer to join our team in this newly created role. As an Integration Developer, you will build and support reliable, secure and high\-performance integrations on the Microsoft Azure platform.


This role will develop integration solutions using Azure Integration Services, with a strong emphasis on resilience, performance, observability and automation. You will also bring strong SQL capability to support integration data, logging, reconciliation and troubleshooting.


We're particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate experience of integrating multiple business\-critical applications, designing resilient interfaces and APIs, and delivering solutions that provide visibility, reliability and long\-term maintainability. Strong Azure integration expertise, SQL skills and experience working within DevOps and Agile delivery environments will be essential.
This is an agile working role with 2\-4 times per month working out of our Coventry office (subject to business need).


This role is part of Technology \& Information where you'll help us give colleagues the infrastructure, support and insight they need to be brilliant.

**What you'll achieve**

**Integration Delivery \-**  

* Develop end\-to\-end integration solutions using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management, and Data Factory.
* Build integrations across enterprise platforms including Dynamics 365, legacy systems and third\-party services.
* Deliver solutions that meet non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability and reliability.
* Diagnose and resolve integration issues, including message failures, retries and performance bottlenecks.
**Reliability, Performance \& Monitoring \-**  

* Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
**Security \& Networking \-**  

* Build secure integrations using private endpoints, VNets and Azure Key Vault.
**DevOps \& Automation \-**  

* Develop CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and YAML.
**SQL \& Data \-**  

* Develop SQL queries, stored procedures and data processes to support integrations.
**Collaboration \& Documentation \-**  

* Produce clear integration documentation and support runbooks.
*Please see the role profile attached above for the full day to day responsibilities.*

**What you'll bring**

**Essential skills**

* Strong experience with Azure Integration Services components. (Azure Logic Apps)
* Proven ability to build reliable, high\-performance integrations.
* Strong SQL and T\-SQL development experience.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
* Good knowledge of integration patterns, API design principles and industry best practices.

**Desirable skills**

* Experience developing and supporting applications using C\# / .NET technologies. Understanding of data transformation and mapping techniques, including tools such as XSLT and Liquid.
* Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform and reporting / visualisation tools.
* Experience contributing to the modernisation and migration of legacy integration platforms and services.

**Why Orbit?**


Choosing us means being rewarded in every sense.


Here’s what you can expect to enjoy with us.

We strive to create an inclusive experience with benefits and wellbeing programmes designed to help you, and your loved ones, to thrive. For a better work life balance, we offer flexible working opportunities for many roles.

**A place to progress**

From training programmes to professional qualifications, we provide opportunities to learn and develop at every stage of your career. Whether you’re a student, graduate or experienced professional we’ll support you to grow.


For leaders, our tailored development journeys are designed to stretch and strengthen your leadership skills. As well as practical training, we give you access to renowned business schools and experiential programmes for greater breadth and depth of learning.

**A purpose to feel proud of**


We’re proud to make a difference to people together. We’re values\-driven with a commercial focus on performance \- because the more profit we make, the more we can achieve for people.


What brings us together is a passionate belief in progress and people.


Read more about the values and purpose that drive us on our careers website.

**How we hire**


We aim to make our hiring process simple and fair:

* Interview(s)
* Decision and offer


We put the safeguarding of our customers, colleagues and contractors at the heart of everything we do and as such, certain roles will be subject to a DBS check.

**Job Description**  

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Group Technology Team in Milton Keynes.



ConnellsX is Connells Group Technology’s internal developer platform, built on Microsoft Azure. It simplifies cloud hosting, embeds security and compliance by default, and enables a frictionless developer experience. As part of the team building and operating this platform, you will play a hands\-on role in ensuring it is reliable, scalable, and observable.



You will help establish and mature SRE practices, focusing on:


* Monitoring and observability
* Incident response
* Post\-incident review
* Reliability testing and capacity planning
* Toil reduction
* Enabling development velocity


We offer a hybrid working arrangement with one day per week in our Milton Keynes office.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Support teams using ConnellsX and respond to incidents in a structured, blameless way
* Investigate root causes and drive post\-incident actions to completion
* Define SLIs, contribute to SLOs, and monitor error budgets
* Build dashboards, alerts, and runbooks to improve visibility
* Automate repetitive tasks to reduce operational toil
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance reliability and observability
* Support performance testing and capacity planning
* Proactively identify and prioritise reliability improvements


**Experience \& Skills Required:**


* Hands\-on experience with Azure Monitoring (Application Insights, Alerts, Action Groups)
* Strong knowledge of OpenTelemetry (including Kubernetes)
* Scripting/automation using PowerShell and/or Azure CLI
* Experience with Terraform and GitHub Actions
* Ability to define SLIs/SLOs and manage error budgets
* Incident response and post\-incident review experience
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
* Strong communication and documentation skills


**Desirable:**


* Working knowledge of .NET/C\# and React/NextJS
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation
* Knowledge of Azure networking (DNS, VNets, Firewalls)
* Understanding of security frameworks (e.g. ISO 27002, NIST CSF)
* Azure certifications


**About You:**



You may come from SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, or operations backgrounds. What matters is hands\-on experience running production systems, managing incidents, creating runbooks and automating repetitive work. The focus is on identifying root causes and systemic issues, reducing manual toil through automation, and maintaining reliability by applying SRE principles and using data‑driven metrics (SLIs/SLOs).



You understand reliability is about balance, not perfection, and can make data\-driven trade\-offs between stability and delivery. You are curious, collaborative, and take shared responsibility for system reliability.


**Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.**


**Connells Group UK** is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

jobs.description:
**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------

We work closely with clients and partners to take full advantage of the opportunities of technology. We mobilize expert teams that create custom solutions from existing and emerging technology to deliver viable outcomes at speed. We call this 'Value in the making.'
  

Part of the Capgemini Group, Sogeti makes business value through technology for organizations that need to implement innovation at speed and want a local partner with global scale. With a hands\-on culture and close proximity to its clients, Sogeti is currently looking for a Automation Test Engineer to join our Quality Engineering and Test Practice, ensuring alignment with business goals and driving impactful value creation for our clients.


*Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.*

*If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre\-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)*

**Your role**
-------------

**Essential Skills:**
---------------------

* Experience in creating effective automation test strategies and plans.
* Experience in test automation using at least two proprietary or OpenSource tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or Tricentis Tosca
* Experience creating or adapting automation frameworks
* Familiarity with at least one OOP language (Java, Python, C\# etc.)
* Creating test scripts within a BDD environment using Cucumber, SpecFlow or similar
* Ability to manage and maintain versions of test assets in GIT and other repositories
* Experience of working in Agile / DevOps environments
* Hands on experience of various test types (manual and automation) such as Functional, API, web and mobility
* Experience with CI / CD Pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar, and integrating automation assets into the pipeline
* Experience of managing a small team of test engineers
* Ability to collaborate with developers, testers, analysts, architects, and other members across the organisation.
  

ISTQB or equivalent certification in testing at foundation level or above (or willingness to obtain an ISTQB Foundation, soon after joining us, which we will cover the cost of the exam)
  

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.


**Mandatory Skills :**
----------------------

* OOP language such as Java, Python, C\#
* Functional Test tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Tricentis Tosca
* Test management tools such as Jira, TFS, OpenText ALM
* Experience of working in waterfall, agile and DevOps environments
* Other tooling such as Postman. Ready API, Soap UI
* Data masking and data subsetting
* BDD approaches using tooling such as Cucumber or SpecFlow
**Your security clearance**
---------------------------

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
  

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
  

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
  

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


**We are a Disability Confident Employer:**
-------------------------------------------

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  

* Declare they have a disability, and
* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.


**What does 'Get The Future You Want' mean for you?**
-----------------------------------------------------

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Management or, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  

You will be encouraged to have a positive work\-life balance. Our hybrid\-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day\-to\-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.


**Why you should consider Capgemini:**
--------------------------------------

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.


**About Capgemini:**
--------------------

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
RLDatix (RLD) is on a mission to help raise the standard of care…everywhere. Trusted by over 10,000 healthcare organizations around the world, our solutions help improve health and care. Our applications ensure that patients receive the best and safest care while supporting the providers who deliver it.



Joining TeamRLD means being part of a global effort of over 2,000 team members in making a difference in healthcare…every day.



We're searching for a Skopje\-based Systems Engineer to join our Business Systems team, so that we can optimise and administer corporate systems to improve operational efficiency and user experience. The Systems Engineer will identify and resolve moderate\-scope technical issues, implement workflow enhancements, and support system upgrades to align technology solutions with business needs across our organisation.

  


**How You'll Spend Your Time**

  


* Identify recurring inefficiencies within business system workflows and implement routine enhancements, documenting and communicating process changes to relevant stakeholders to ensure consistent adoption and an improved user experience
* Troubleshoot moderate\-scope technical system issues by systematically diagnosing root causes and applying timely resolutions, classifying and escalating complex operational challenges within established frameworks
* Research current market trends and emerging technologies in order to evaluate solutions that fulfil organisational requirements and align system strategies with business objectives
* Perform system administration and technical support activities to meet established service levels and timelines, monitoring system performance and user adoption metrics to ensure productive working environments and stakeholder satisfaction
* Perform operational deployment tasks for system rollouts following detailed change management procedures, coordinating with stakeholders and supporting ongoing adoption through user training and documentation
* Perform compliance checks within system administration activities in order to ensure adherence to data protection requirements and regulatory standards across technology platforms and user access management

**What Kind of Things We're Most Interested in You Having**

  


* Strong knowledge of the T\-SQL programming language and database concepts, relational theory, OLAP, Linked servers, ODBC connections and drivers, along with Microsoft SQL Server deployment, maintenance, and configuration
* Experience with the Microsoft Azure environment and hosted cloud VMs, backup/restore procedures, High availability, AAD, Enterprise Apps, and Bastion
* In\-depth knowledge on how to develop dashboards using a data visualization tool such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar, and experience with integration and automation tools such as Boomi
* Proficiency with PowerShell and Python, as well as API management tools such as Postman; nice\-to\-have experience with WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL, SharePoint administration and development, and C\#
* Proven success analysing business processes and supporting the implementation of improved workflows across corporate systems, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve moderate\-scope technical issues that maintain operational effectiveness
* Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance practices for system administration and data protection, a track record of delivering timely system administration, support, and documentation, and a knack for working collaboratively within a global team

By enabling flexibility in how we work and prioritizing employee wellness, we empower our team to do and be their best. Key benefits include private health and group accident insurance, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for confidential support, and Loyalty Awards for long\-service employees.



RLDatix is an equal opportunity employer, and our employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, handicap, marital status or any other status or condition protected by law.



As part of RLDatix's commitment to the inclusion of all qualified individuals, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation in the job application and interview process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in either step, please don't hesitate to send a note to accessibility@rldatix.com.



Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including location, relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also taken into consideration.
