**Technologie:** Vue 3 (@vue/compat, kompatybilność z Vue 2\), JavaScript, TypeScript, Vite 5, Vuex 4, Vue Router 4, Axios, SignalR, BootstrapVue 2, Bootstrap 4, Tailwind CSS, Jest, ESLint, Prettier, ApexCharts, Plotly.js, Power BI Client, Google Maps, PDF.js, Azure.

  

  

**Zadania:**

* Rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji frontendowej opartej o Vue 3 działającej w trybie kompatybilności z Vue 2\.
* Tworzenie nowych funkcjonalności oraz rozwijanie istniejących modułów zgodnie z wymaganiami biznesowymi.
* Praca z Vuex oraz vue\-router przy rozwoju architektury aplikacji i zarządzaniu stanem.
* Integracja z backendem .NET poprzez warstwę serwisową opartą o axios oraz implementacja komunikacji czasu rzeczywistego z wykorzystaniem SignalR.
* Tworzenie i rozwijanie formularzy, walidacji oraz interfejsów użytkownika z wykorzystaniem Bootstrap, BootstrapVue i Tailwind CSS.
* Budowanie raportów oraz wizualizacji danych z wykorzystaniem ApexCharts, Plotly.js i Power BI.
* Integracja z usługami zewnętrznymi, takimi jak Google Maps, PDF.js, FullStory czy rozwiązania związane z bezpiecznym przetwarzaniem płatności.
* Dbanie o jakość kodu poprzez stosowanie ESLint, Prettier oraz zespołowych standardów programistycznych.
* Tworzenie i aktualizacja testów jednostkowych w środowisku Jest.
* Współpraca z zespołem backendowym, analitykami oraz interesariuszami biznesowymi przy projektowaniu i wdrażaniu nowych rozwiązań.
  

  

**Nasze oczekiwania:**

* Minimum 4 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w obszarze frontend developmentu.
* Bardzo dobra znajomość Vue.js, w tym doświadczenie zarówno z Vue 3, jak i Vue 2\.
* Znajomość Composition API, Options API oraz starszych wzorców charakterystycznych dla aplikacji rozwijanych w Vue 2\.
* Doświadczenie w pracy z Vite jako narzędziem do budowania aplikacji.
* Praktyczna znajomość Vuex oraz Vue Router.
* Umiejętność pracy z hybrydowym podejściem do stylowania aplikacji (Bootstrap/BootstrapVue oraz Tailwind CSS).
* Doświadczenie w integracji aplikacji frontendowych z backendem poprzez REST API, z wykorzystaniem Axios oraz SignalR.
* Znajomość dobrych praktyk związanych z bezpieczeństwem danych i integracjami płatniczymi.
* Doświadczenie w pisaniu i utrzymywaniu testów automatycznych z wykorzystaniem Jest.
* Dbałość o wysoką jakość kodu oraz znajomość narzędzi i praktyk takich jak ESLint, Prettier, code review oraz praca zgodnie z ustalonymi standardami architektonicznymi.
* Samodzielność, proaktywność oraz umiejętność realizacji zadań od analizy wymagań po wdrożenie rozwiązania.
* Komunikatywność, proaktywność i gotowość do dzielenia się wiedzą.
* Znajomość języka polskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną współpracę w zespole.
* Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym skuteczną komunikację z klientem (preferowany poziom C1\).
* Możliwość zapewnienia co najmniej 4 godzin wspólnej dostępności z klientem działającym w strefie Eastern Time.
  

  

**Mile widziane:**

* Doświadczenie w projektach z obszaru fintech, płatności lub compliance.
* Znajomość środowiska Microsoft Azure.
* Podstawowa wiedza z obszaru ubezpieczeń (polisy, szkody, cesje).
* Doświadczenie we współpracy z klientami zagranicznymi.
  

  

**Model pracy:** 100% zdalnie


**Czas trwania projektu:** ponad 12 miesięcy

  

  

**Godziny pracy** : Elastycznie, ale godziny pracy muszą zapewniać co najmniej 4 godziny wspólnej dostępności z klientem działającym w strefie Eastern Time (wschodnie wybrzeże USA). Największe natężenie spotkań u klienta jest w godzinach 14:00 – 18:00\.

  

  

**Przebieg procesu rekrutacyjnego:**

* Screening i rozmowa techniczna
* Opcjonalna rozmowa z klientem
* Decyzja
  

  

**WAŻNE INFORMACJE:**

* W trakcie procesu rekrutacyjnego, na kolejnych jego etapach, wymagana będzie weryfikacja tożsamości kandydata.
* Pierwszy dzień pracy odbywać się będzie stacjonarnie w jednym z biur Euvic (onboarding, odbiór sprzętu).

Join our **Core Experience NL Team** at LeoVegas Group, where you will play a crucial role in enhancing our global customer onboarding process and developing responsible gaming features. Your work will ensure a seamless, secure, and enjoyable experience for our customers across all our brands.

Our mission is to create a safe gaming environment where players can set healthy limits on their gambling habits. We leverage data\-driven insights and a robust CI/CD process, following the Agile (Scrum/Kanban) methodology to deliver high\-quality solutions. You will collaborate alongside expert developers from four different expertises: Backend, Frontend, and Native apps, Regulatory reporting; along with dedicated Quality Assurance Engineers to deliver high\-quality solutions that support a reliable and user oriented product.

**YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:**

* Driving high\-impact outcomes by leading complex, ambitious projects and resolving critical issues that directly influence business quality and performance
* Elevating engineering quality across the company through mentoring, sponsorship and delivering constructive technical feedback
* Shaping testing strategy and architecture by leading test design for complex problems, ensuring reliability, observability and alignment with business priorities
* Communicating risks, insights and technical considerations clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders, contributing meaningfully to roadmaps and planning
* Uplifting QA practices across squads by promoting best practices, anticipating issues through strong processes and enabling others to improve testing for performance, scale and security

**OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:**

**Essential Skills:**

* Deep knowledge of testing theory, design techniques, methodologies, and the testing pyramid
* Hands\-on web E2E test automation experience with Playwright (or similar tools) using TypeScript or JavaScript
* Hands\-on native mobile E2E test automation experience with Appium and WebdriverIO (or similar tools) using TypeScript or JavaScript
* Proven ability to design and execute full\-stack test plans and robust manual testing for web and native mobile applications
* Solid grounding in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and DevOps methodologies within self\-organizing teams

**Nice to Have:**

* ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or higher)
* Hands\-on experience with test management tools like TestRail
* Practical experience maintaining and optimizing automated testing within CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with microservice architectures (Java/Kotlin, Kafka, MySQL, REST APIs, BigQuery)
* Experience building automated API tests and working with mock data or virtualization tools
* Prior experience in the iGaming industry
* Leadership experience in driving test strategies, setting best practices, and steering QA projects would be a strong advantage

**WHO WE ARE:**


At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast\-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

**BENEFITS:**

* Hybrid work policy
* 4 weeks of Workation *(T\&C apply)*

* Our office provides complimentary snacks and drinks; on Mondays, we serve complimentary breakfast
* Team and office social events throughout the year
* Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles
* Free gym in the building
* Equipment: MacBook Pro \+ smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25\)

**JOIN US!**


In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!


Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride \- give us a roar!

  

As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your **CV in English**, please.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment


Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting\-edge cloud technologies.


Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices


Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.


Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment


Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues


Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories


##### **Skills**


Must have


Python,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD

Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP\-600/DP\-700 certifications),


experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated,


PowerShell.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Please note that to qualify for this role, you must be located in Poland and hold a valid work permit.**  

  

We’re looking for an **Engineering Manager** who brings together three key areas: **people leadership, delivery and engineering processes, and contribution to the wider IT organization** and knows how to turn them into real impact.  

  

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll report to one of the IT Directors and act as part of IT leadership within the development teams. Working with up to **three teams and 18 direct reports** you’ll lead and grow people, shape the way teams work, and drive continuous improvements in development processes. Beyond your team, you’ll work closely with other Engineering Managers and Product Managers, contributing to initiatives that move IT forward.  

  

We’re looking for someone who **thrives on change**, **brings energy, curiosity and proactivity** to their work and knows how to inspire others to do the same. Active coding isn’t part of the role, but you’ll need enough technical depth to understand, challenge and evaluate technical decisions, support your engineers and ensure they deliver high\-quality code.  

  

**About us:** GetResponse is a SaaS company recognized for its industry\-leading email marketing and marketing automation software. We’ve been serving our customers since 1998 and are proud to have 350,000\+ SMBs and 1,000\+ enterprise customers on board.

  

  

Key responsibilities:**Lead and support your teams**

* take ownership of team performance and key results, working closely with teams and Product Managers
* monitor team progress, health and predictability across sprints, cycles and projects
* drive continuous improvement of how the teams plan, work and deliver
* identify and resolve problems, remove impediments and ensure teams have the tools and resources they need
* take responsibility for hiring team budgets, visibility and recognition
* support team culture and team\-building activities
* take care of the teams’ communication channels

 **Develop and support people**

* take ownership of the performance and development of people in your teams
* provide regular feedback and conduct performance evaluations, considering both soft skills and technical aspects
* co\-create career paths, set short\- and long\-term goals, and support people in achieving them
* encourage continuous development and help people achieve better results
* provide coaching and mentoring when needed and identify training needs
* manage salaries, absences, expenses and bonuses

 **Contribute to IT**

* represent IT within your teams and work closely with other Engineering Managers
* contribute to the IT strategy and drive initiatives that develop and improve the department
* support knowledge sharing across teams and people
* support guild activities

  

You may be a perfect fit if you have:* 5\+ years of experience in similar roles (e.g. Engineering Manager, Team Leader)
* a proven track record in people management and leadership
* experience with two or more programming languages or have played an important role on the technical side of software development
* practical experience with GitLab, Jira, Claude / ChatGPT
* a master's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
* excellent Polish language skills and English at B2\+ level

  

**Nice to have:*** a background as a developer or architect
* experience working in\-house for a product development company
* a background in SaaS product companies
* experience working in agile environments

  

We are looking for someone who is:* open\-minded and has a welcome\-change attitude
* ready to work in an inspect\-and\-adapt
* positive, with high professional standards and a strong work ethic
* passionate and creative as a modern IT manager
* comfortable thinking outside the box
* focused on high\-quality solutions
* able to inspire both juniors and experts with enthusiasm for technology

  

Salary range:* contract of employment: 17,430–27,020 PLN gross per month
* B2B contract: 1,000–1,550 PLN net per man\-day

  

Extra perks include: \** we work in a hybrid model for those based in the Tri\-City area; employees based outside the area work fully remotely
* home office setup – a one\-time bonus of up to 1,000 PLN (or equivalent) to help set up your home office space
* private medical care for employees and their family members
* employee referral program – up to 10,000 PLN for recommending a friend
* corporate life insurance
* employee pension program (PPE)
* wellbeing and mental health culture – mental health helpline, sport card, etc.
* modern equipment – most of our teams work on MacBooks
* English language classes
* internal initiatives like webinars, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and more
* Some benefits may be available only to talents hired under a contract of employment.

  

  

Apply and enjoy our fully remote online recruitment process!* **Review stage:** We’ll check your CV to screen for various criteria and match your talents with opportunities.
* **Phone interview:** We’d like to get to know you, and vice versa. Let us know why you want to join our team and why you’d be a great fit to us.
* **First interview:** It’s your chance to shine and show that you’re the perfect fit for the role. You’ll meet your future manager, go through the High\-level System Design Interview, and get a real feel for what the job looks like in practice.
* **IT Leadership Panel:** Engage with our IT Management Team in a dynamic discussion, where you can demonstrate your skills and get a feel for our culture – ensuring mutual fit and setting you up for success.
* **Offer:** If you have what it takes, accept our offer – and welcome aboard! Join our team and be in great company!

 **To help us review your application smoothly, please submit your CV in English.**

  

Magda is the recruiter responsible for this process – if you have any additional questions, feel free to contact her!

jobs.title: Solutions Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800\+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.



Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource\-library/customer\-stories

**About the role:**



As a Solutions Platform Engineer, you'll build and run the technical infrastructure that supports Appfire's Solutions Group. You'll own our demo environments end to end, build self\-service sandboxes for Solution Partners, and automate technical processes that enable Sales Engineers and Solutions Architects to spend more time with customers. You'll also help transition successful field\-built prototypes into production by partnering with Engineering and DevOps on code ownership, hosting, and support models. This is a highly cross\-functional role focused on reducing technical overhead, improving time\-to\-demo, and creating scalable solutions infrastructure.


**What you'll do:**


* Own the demo estate end to end, including Atlassian instance provisioning, realistic seeded datasets, multi\-product reference environments, and environment teardown and refresh.
* Build and maintain self\-service sandbox environments that enable Solution Partners to demonstrate Appfire products independently.
* Design and implement automation that reduces technical overhead for Sales Engineering and Solutions Architecture teams and improves time\-to\-demo.
* Maintain the technical knowledge base supporting security questionnaires, RFPs, and trust center responses.
* Run the Instance Optimization inventory extract and pricing pull supporting Appfire's consolidation assessment.
* Take ownership of field\-built prototypes that graduate to production, including code ownership, hosting, deployment, and ongoing support in partnership with Engineering and DevOps.
* Define and enforce technical graduation criteria for prototypes moving from pilot to production, ensuring each solution has clear ownership, hosting, and support models.
* Monitor demo environment health, provisioning performance, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving technical bottlenecks.


**What you'll need:**


* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or systems engineering, ideally supporting a sales engineering, solutions, or presales organization.
* Hands\-on experience administering and provisioning Atlassian Cloud and/or Data Center environments, including Jira, Confluence, and/or Bitbucket.
* Experience building and operating self\-service sandbox or demo environments, including environment lifecycle management and seeded or synthetic data.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation, scripting such as Python or Bash, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices.
* Practical experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling.
* Experience taking ownership of existing tools or prototypes and preparing them for production, including code review, hosting, deployment, and support.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge bases for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Solutions, Sales Engineering, Product Engineering, and DevOps teams in a fast\-moving environment.


**What we offer:**


* Help build the technical platform and operating model that enables Appfire's Solutions organization to scale.
* Opportunity to define and automate how demo environments, partner sandboxes, and field\-built solutions are built and operated.
* Work across Appfire's product portfolio and the Atlassian ecosystem with direct impact on how our solutions teams support customers and partners


**Company Equity:** Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a strong sense of ownership and connection to our growth.


**Time Off \& Wellbeing**


* 26 Vacation Days: Paid vacation annually, regardless of tenure  

Wellness Days: 1 fully paid day off each month for rest, recovery, or unexpected personal needs  

Volunteering: 24 hours of paid volunteer time plus 3 fully paid volunteering days


**Learning \& Development**


* Appfire University: Custom, on\-demand learning platform supporting continuous learning, professional development, and career growth
* Health \& Insurance
* Private Healthcare: Fully covered Luxmed plan, with the option to extend coverage to your partner or add personalized upgrades  

Life Insurance: Fully paid UNUM life insurance


**Lifestyle \& Everyday Benefits**


* MyBenefit: 150 PLN per month for a Multisport card, shopping, restaurants, and entertainment
* Lunch Card: 300 PLN per month for groceries or dining out via a virtual Pluxee card, with Google Pay and Apple Wallet support
* Remote Work Support


**Home Office Allowance:** 200 PLN net per month to help cover electricity and internet costs while working remotely

 **Market recognition**



Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000\. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.


**Equal Employer Opportunity (EEO)**

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

jobs.description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. **Your career opportunity**  

We develop and maintain the tools for Product Control. The tools comprise mostly of Fair Value Adjustments and Independent Price verification processes and regulatory Stress Testing. We are looking to extend the capabilities of existing tools and building new ones. Our current efforts are focused on developing a new platform and phasing out the aging application. The new platform is based on a microservice architecture, modular user interface, queues, and orchestration. **What you’ll do*** Develop new features and being responsible for maintaining live processes
* Have access to AI tools: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot
* Create secure solutions confirmed by cybersecurity reports
* Review colleagues code and proactively suggest optimizations, increased security, etc.
* Provide input to test plans and testing strategies as well as input to design discussions and project planning meetings.
* Engage with multiple stakeholder groups
* Work in PODs to help deliver Stories / Tasks and provide the Functional Support in Production tickets / Incidents on rota basis
* Use, Configure and Manage Changes in CI CD Tools

 **What you need to have to succeed in this role*** Excellent and proven by experience understanding of C\# .net programming
* Good understanding of SQL and knowledge of non\-relational databases
* Understanding of Python programming, PySpark experience will be a plus
* Knowledge of design patterns and the ability to read and create technical documentation
* AI literacy – prompting, understanding limitations, safety etc.
* Communication skills, both verbal and written
* Prior experience and/or understanding of Product Control Valuation domain involving Fair Value Adjustments, Independent Price Verification (IPV) and Bid Offer (BO) processes

 **What we offer**


The pay range for this role is 17 484 PLN \- 26 225 PLN (monthly, gross).  

Variable pay is discretionary, but influenced by Group performance, business/function performance and individual performance.

jobs.title: 3D Platform Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description** **Hej 3D Platform Engineer,**

**Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?**


With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

 **Your new job**


You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.


We’re looking for a 3D Platform Engineer to build the shared capabilities behind IKEA’s next generation of 3D digital planning and product experiences. You will transform complex CAD and PLM product data into reliable, scalable 3D assets and services—covering tessellation, mesh optimization, LOD generation, and preservation of visual and geometric fidelity. Your work will make high\-quality 3D product data easier to use across customer\-facing planning solutions, content production, and product development. On a typical week, you will:

* Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle\-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C\#, C\+\+, and Python.
* Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well\-defined development briefs.
* Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product\-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
* Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
* Build automated CAD\-to\-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
* Develop and validate mesh\-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high\-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
* Benchmark and integrate commercial and open\-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud\-based 3D processing services.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**


As a 3D Platform Engineer, you combine strong software engineering with practical knowledge of 3D data, pipelines, and runtime needs. You can work across the full flow—from CAD and PLM sources to optimized assets and scalable services. You should also bring:

* A strong understanding of computer graphics, real\-time and offline rendering, and production\-ready 3D asset pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
* Knowledge of product\-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
* Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
* A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business\-critical services in an agile environment.
* A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong C\+\+ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third\-party libraries.
* Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
* Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.


Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C\+\+, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh\-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all\- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.


It’s a plus if you also bring:

* Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
* Experience with mesh\-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!**

jobs.title: Software Developer to Qurant – Join our growing health tech team
jobs.description:
#### **About us**


Qurant is on a mission to make employee health more proactive, measurable and sustainable.  

Through our health platform and close collaboration with HR and leadership teams, we help organisations spot early signs of ill health and build healthier workplaces. We are proud of our customer satisfaction and are growing our team to help even more companies make proactive health a natural part of working life.  

Qurant is an independent company within the Capio Group.

#### **About the role**


We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our growing product team.  

You will work across our product: a Laravel\-based web portal used by Swedish employers to manage employee absence and health, as well as a new mobile app currently in development.  

We are a small team, which means no rigid “web person” or “mobile person” roles. We collaborate, learn from each other and pitch in where the product needs us. You will help build new features, improve performance and reliability, and make thoughtful improvements to an established codebase.  

As we work with sensitive personal data, quality, security and good engineering practices matter a lot to us.

#### **What you’ll do**

* Develop and maintain features across our web portal and mobile app
* Work hands\-on with PHP, Laravel, relational databases and integrations
* Improve application and database performance, including queries and indexing
* Navigate technical debt, legacy patterns and ongoing improvements with pragmatism
* Collaborate on code reviews, technical decisions and product development
* Work with Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployments
* Learn new technologies and contribute wherever the team needs you

#### **We think you’ll thrive here if you have**

* 5\+ years of experience building and maintaining production software
* Strong experience with a server\-rendered web framework, such as Laravel, Symfony, Rails, Django or ASP.NET Core
* A genuine interest in working with PHP and Laravel day to day
* Solid relational database skills, including query optimisation and performance troubleshooting
* Experience working in existing codebases—not just greenfield projects
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and a major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to pick up unfamiliar technologies
* Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a strong advantage

##### **Nice to have**
**Experience with any of the following is a bonus:**

* Flutter, React Native or native mobile development
* GDPR or sensitive personal data in healthcare, finance or another regulated setting
* Multi\-tenant SaaS products
* AI coding assistants and agentic workflows
* Livewire, Alpine.js, Blade, Vue, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Kubernetes or PostgreSQL

##### **For the technically curious (and the proud tech nerds), here’s our stack:**

  

Laravel / PHP, Livewire 3, Alpine.js, Blade, Bootstrap 5 / SCSS, MySQL / MariaDB, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions and Azure Container Apps with Bicep.  

Our mobile app is built in Flutter. We also work with OAuth, webhooks, SFTP\-based file flows and integrations such as Försäkringskassan. Some parts of the frontend still use jQuery—because real\-life codebases are rarely built in a day.

#### **What we offer**

* A meaningful role in a growing health\-tech company
* A collaborative team with plenty of room to influence both product and technology
* The chance to work across web, mobile, cloud and integrations
* Central Stockholm offices on Drottninggatan, with hybrid work options

##### **How to apply**


Want to help us build healthier workplaces across Sweden? We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.  

Start date: autumn or as agreed.  

  

**Questions?**  

Contact Sandra Jakobsson at **sandra.jakobsson@capio.se**

**What you'll do**  

* You will be challenged with designing and building the next generation of our backend services. Balancing hands\-on programming with technical strategy, you will work alongside senior developers to shape long\-term architectural roadmaps, take ownership of core backend domains, and foster collaboration across teams and key stakeholders.
  

Our services are primarily implemented in Go, with parts extending into C\+\+, Python, and JavaScript.
  

We are seeking someone with strong experience building scalable backend infrastructure and maintaining robust, reliable codebases. Prior games industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

	+ Strong knowledge of backend programming in Go, Python, C\#

	+ Extensive experience from storage technologies such as MySQL, NoSQL, Redis or Memcache

	+ Extensive experience running services in commercial clouds or Kubernetes

	+ A great sense of technical excellence, functionality and problem\-solving
Excellent verbal and written English  


	+ **Bonus Qualifications**
	+ Experience from the Video Game industry

	+ Knowledge of Javascript and C\+\+

	+ Previous work with high availability solutions

	+ Passionate about gaming

Du har också erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med React, Angular eller Next.js samt av cloud, Azure, CI/CD och DevOps.

Som senior fullstackutvecklare utvecklar och vidareutvecklar du system som används i produktion. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från teknisk analys och systemdesign till implementation, test och produktionssättning.

TypeScript

jobs.title: AI Agent Developer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

  

At If Insurance, we are scaling Agentic AI into everyday operations to support our employees and customers. Our AIKA Squad, part of the Intelligent Automation Enabler, develops and operates AI agents and agent platforms that help automate business processes across the If organization.

  

  

We are now looking for experienced Agentic AI Developers who can combine strong software and AI engineering skills with hands\-on experience in the n8n AI workflow automation platform.

  

  

In this role, you will develop capabilities for our AIKA Agent platform and build end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows with n8n. You will connect agents, business systems, data sources and human decision points into secure, reliable production solutions.

  

  

If you are excited about LLMs, agentic systems, workflow automation, enterprise\-grade architecture and turning AI into tangible business value, you will feel at home with us.

  

  

You will:

  

  

* Design, build and operate AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, using tools and collaborating with other agents
* Build end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows using n8n
* Develop reusable capabilities and integrations for our AIKA Agent platform
* Connect AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources and business processes
* Design workflows that integrate deterministic automation, such as RPA, with generative AI and human decision\-making
* Implement robust evaluation, tracing, monitoring, error handling and safety controls
* Apply secure engineering practices to credentials, identities, data access and integrations
* Work closely with business teams to take use cases from initial idea to production
* Contribute to shared development standards, reusable components and platform governance
  

  

  

**We offer**

  

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

  

* An inclucive work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit
  

  

  

**About the team**

  

You’ll be working at the heart of If, collaborating across all If countries, Business Areas, Tribes, and Squads, as well as with the whole IT organization.

  

  

Our international Intelligent Automation unit consists of skilled professionals across six locations: Espoo, Turku, Copenhagen, Riga, Vilnius, and Kuala Lumpur. We have already successfully scaled RPA as well as Generative AI assistants across the company and are now on track with Agentic AI journey. We take pride in our supportive culture, modern tooling, and the real opportunities for growth in this high\-impact domain.

  

  

  

**Who are you?**

  

You are a pragmatic software engineer with a strong interest in Agentic AI and intelligent workflow automation. You enjoy solving complex problems by combining AI models, software components, APIs and business systems into reliable end\-to\-end solutions.

  

  

You balance experimentation with engineering discipline, security and operational reliability. You are comfortable taking ownership, collaborating across organizational boundaries and working hands\-on with solutions that run in production.

  

  

You do not need to be an AI researcher. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building dependable systems that create measurable value.

  

  

You have experience of:

  

  

Agent \& LLM Development


* Designing and building production workflows with n8n
* Hands\-on experience with Azure OpenAI
* LLM orchestration (agents, tools, function calling, routing, planners)
* Familiarity with evaluation and observability tools for LLM systems
  

  

Microsoft \& Cloud


* Azure AI / MS Foundry
* Microsoft Agent Framework (or similar agent frameworks)
* Azure services: Functions, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Event Grid, API Management
* Networking, identity and access using Entra ID
  

  

Software Engineering


* C\# (.NET), TypeScript/React, or Python (ideally more than one)
* CI/CD with Azure DevOps
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform or Bicep)
* Designing reliable cloud\-native applications and integrations
* MCP\-based tool and system integration
* LLM supported development tools like GitHub Copilot
  

  

  

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**

  

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 7, 2026\.


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the recruiting system.


**Work location:** Even though the majority of the team is located in Turku, the position is open in Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen, Espoo and Turku.


**Travelling:** Some travelling in the Nordic countries is required.


**Start:** As soon as possible/by agreement.

  

  

For more information, please contact Asko Mustonen, Head of Intelligent Automation (asko.mustonen@if.fi)

  

  

Background checks will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.

  

  

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
**Cloud Engineer**

**Team: Engineering \- Location: Stockholm**

  

Pacera unifies financial close, consolidation and FP\&A into one intelligent platform. With AARO, Aico and Mercur, finance teams turn trusted data into AI\-driven insight — powering robust, scalable, and smarter decision\-making for the Office of the CFO.

 **About the role**


We're looking for a Mid/Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Infrastructure team of 6 and help operate and maintain the production environment behind our SaaS platform. You'll work across a hybrid environment of Windows and Linux virtual machines, supporting applications built on .NET and Java, running on top of VMware and OpenStack, with some services also running in Azure.
  

  

Our environment relies heavily on client VPNs and IPSEC point\-to\-point tunnels for remote and site connectivity, so extensive networking and firewall skills are essential.  

  

We manage our infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code, so solid coding/scripting skills are necessary for this role. This is a hands\-on operational role focused on keeping our platform reliable, secure, and performing well in production.

 **What You'll Do**

* Maintain and monitor production infrastructure for our SaaS platform, ensuring high availability and performance
* Manage and troubleshoot both Windows and Linux virtual machines in production environments
* Administer and optimize virtualization infrastructure on VMware and OpenStack
* Manage and troubleshoot client VPN access and IPSEC point\-to\-point tunnels, working with firewalls and network infrastructure
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and performance of .NET and Java applications running in production
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code to provision, configure, and manage our environment
* Respond to and resolve incidents, performing root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
* Perform routine maintenance tasks: patching, updates, backups, and capacity planning
* Log, track, and update work using our ticketing system; collaborate with development teams to support releases and deployments into production
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and automation to reduce manual operational work
* Maintain documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbook

**What We're Looking For**


Must\-haves:

* Several years' hands\-on experience administering both Windows Server and Linux environments in production
* Experience with OpenStack or comparable private cloud/IaaS platforms
* Familiarity supporting production applications built on Java
* Solid networking and firewall knowledge, including experience with client VPNs and IPSEC site\-to\-site tunnels
* Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, OS, and application layers
* Comfortable owning incidents in a production environment with high uptime requirements
* Solid coding/scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) and experience with Infrastructure as Code
* Experience with Datadog or similar observability platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bicep
* Experience working with Jira or a similar ticketing/issue\-tracking system


Nice\-to\-haves:

* Experience with NixOS
* Experience with container\-based environments (e.g Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with Microsoft Azure (or another public cloud) in a production setting
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
* Familiarity with firewall platforms (Clavister, Fortinet)
* Relevant certifications (VMware VCP, Linux, Microsoft/Azure, OpenStack, or networking certs like CCNA)
* Prior experience in a SaaS or always\-on production environment

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to be part of our next phase of growth and expansion, backed by strategic private equity investment
* Competitive compensation and benefits package including pension, flex hours, wellness allowances and more
* Hybrid working options

**About Pacera**  

Pacera is redefining financial operations for the Office of the CFO — powering planning, financial close, consolidation, and reporting through one unified platform, trusted by 700\+ organisations and 70,000\+ users across more than 140 countries.


Our platform brings together three specialised products — **Aico by Pacera**, **AARO by Pacera**, and **Mercur by Pacera** — giving finance teams the accuracy, control, and confidence they need to run mission\-critical operations, without compromise.

* **Aico** automates and streamlines financial close processes
* **Mercur** powers FP\&A, budgeting, forecasting, business intelligence, and financial analytics
* **AARO** delivers consolidation and group reporting solutions
  

Each product has a loyal customer base and a strong track record of growth. Built on decades of proven expertise, our platform helps finance and executive leaders automate, govern, and make faster, smarter decisions.

  

We're headquartered in Stockholm, with offices across Sweden, Finland, Latvia, and the UK. And we're driven by the same principles wherever we are: collaboration, continuous learning, flexibility, curiosity, and the drive to win together.

  

Backed by Accel\-KKR, a global technology\-focused investment firm, the group has ambitious growth plans driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions. We are now strengthening our operations by investing in key roles that support our platform and future scalability.

 **Apply now**


This is a permanent, full\-time position. The role will be based in Stockholm.

  

Our process typically involves an initial conversation with our recruitment team, a hiring manager interview, and a final stage interview including a role specific task.

  

We warmly welcome your application.

  

\-

 *Please note; as part of our recruitment process, we carry out reference checks, ID verification, and background screening. All roles include a probationary period, as set out in the employment contract*

jobs.title: Digital Solution Engineer - Azure Platform, French Speaking
jobs.description:
**Overview**  


Azure is a $100B business growing at more than 40% year over year at Microsoft — and application modernization is one of the largest driver of that growth. Customers are no longer asking whether to move to the cloud; they are asking which Azure destination is right for each application, and how fast they can get there. That decision is where you come in.
Are you curious, passionate about infrastructure and applications, and ready to solve complex modernization challenges in the AI era? Join us as a Digital Solution Engineer – Azure Platform, supporting mid\-market customers across the Azure application and data platform.
In this technical sales role, you will help customers move beyond lift\-and\-shift and re\-platform their application estate onto the best\-fit Azure destination — Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, or Azure Kubernetes Service — backed by the right data platform, whether that is Azure SQL or an open\-source engine such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. You will translate architectural choices into business outcomes: lower run cost, faster release cadence, stronger security posture, and an application estate that is ready for AI.
About SME\&C
At Small, Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME\&C), we are leading a high\-growth, AI\-powered global sales team — one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.
SME\&C is more than a sales organization — it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high\-performing, and customer\-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, digital\-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME\&C can be the next step in your career.
The Core of the Role: Driving Application Modernization
The defining capability of this role is your ability to take a customer’s existing application portfolio and drive it to the most appropriate Azure destination — on both the application and the data tier. This is a judgment\-led discipline, not a template. You are expected to assess each workload on its operational model, scale profile, cost envelope, compliance constraints, and the customer’s developer velocity, then recommend and defend the right landing zone.
Application platform destinations
You are fluent across the full Azure application platform and can articulate — with credibility, in front of architects — when to choose each:* Azure App Service — for web apps and APIs that benefit from a fully managed PaaS runtime with minimal operational overhead; the fastest path off Windows/IIS and Java/Tomcat estates.
* Azure Container Apps — for containerized microservices, event\-driven workloads, and scale\-to\-zero scenarios where teams want containers without owning a cluster.
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — for complex, large\-scale, or portability\-driven estates that require full orchestration control, custom networking, and platform\-engineering maturity.
* Azure Functions, Azure Arc, and Azure VMs — as complementary destinations for event\-driven code, hybrid and edge estates, and workloads that are expected to remain IaaS in the near term.


Critically, you can explain the trade\-offs between these destinations rather than defaulting to one — including the cost, operational, and skills implications of each choice, and the containerization and refactoring path required to get there.
Data platform destinations
Modernizing the application without modernizing the data tier leaves most of the value on the table. You bring equal depth across the Azure database estate:* Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance — for modernizing SQL Server estates to PaaS, including compatibility assessment, Hyperscale, and Business Critical tiering.
* SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines — where full instance control or third\-party dependencies require IaaS, with a defined path to PaaS over time.
* Azure Database for PostgreSQL (Flexible Server) — including Oracle\-to\-PostgreSQL modernization and PostgreSQL as the default open\-source landing zone for new and refactored applications.
* Azure Database for MySQL (Flexible Server) — for LAMP\-stack and ISV application estates moving off self\-managed MySQL or MariaDB.
* Azure Cosmos DB — including the MongoDB (vCore) and PostgreSQL APIs, for globally distributed, high\-throughput, and NoSQL workloads.


You are comfortable leading open\-source database conversations on their own merits — licensing economics, extension compatibility, high availability, and migration tooling — and can run an Oracle, MongoDB, or self\-managed PostgreSQL/MySQL modernization conversation end to end.
Modernization method* Lead portfolio\-level assessment and apply the 6R framework (rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, rebuild, replace) to segment an estate and sequence the work.
* Apply containerization and refactoring leading practices, and use AI and intelligent agents to accelerate legacy code assessment, dependency mapping, and transformation.
* Design the surrounding architecture — hybrid and cloud\-native networking, virtual networks, private connectivity, secure routing, identity, and landing\-zone design — so modernized applications meet enterprise performance and compliance requirements.
* Complement Microsoft technology with trusted partner solutions such as NetApp, VMware, Red Hat, and SAP to deliver a secure, optimized, and scalable migration experience.
* Ground every recommendation in Azure security services and compliance frameworks, so customers meet regulatory requirements and build a cloud estate that is ready for what comes next.


This Opportunity Will Allow You To* Accelerate your career growth by leading the modernization engagements that sit at the centre of a $100M, \+40% YoY growth business.
* Deepen your technical proficiency through hands\-on architecture design, application and database migration planning, and implementation of hybrid and cloud\-native environments.
* Develop strategic influence by shaping the destination decisions — App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Azure SQL, or open\-source databases — that determine a customer’s cost base and agility for years.
* Strengthen your collaboration skills by working closely with engineering teams, partners, and customer stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.
* Build future\-ready capabilities through continuous learning, industry\-recognized certifications, and exposure to Microsoft’s evolving application, data, security, and AI platform.

  


**Responsibilities**  

* Drive technical sales using architecture design sessions, technical demos, proofs of concept, and modernization accelerators to influence solution design and unblock deployment.
* Own the destination recommendation — assess customer application portfolios and recommend the best\-fit Azure application and data platform target, with a defensible rationale on cost, scale, operations, and developer velocity.
* Lead application modernization workshops and migration assessments spanning App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Azure SQL, and open\-source database options.
* Build trusted relationships with platform leads, application owners, and data teams to co\-design secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient solutions.
* Resolve technical blockers by collaborating with engineering, partners, and product teams, and channel customer insight back into the product.
* Maintain deep expertise across cloud migration and modernization — Windows, Linux, .NET, Java, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and containerized workloads — alongside resiliency, security, and compliance.
* Deepen knowledge of enterprise applications (SAP, Oracle) and Azure VMware Solution (AVS) as adjacent modernization paths.
* Represent Microsoft in customer forums and technical communities through thought leadership on application and data modernization.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Extensive technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND demonstrated technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
* OR Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND demonstrated technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
* OR equivalent experience
* Proven experience driving application modernization to cloud platforms, including migration and replatforming of workloads such as Windows, Linux, .NET, Java, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.
* Hands\-on experience with managed application platforms and container services — Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — and with containerization strategy.
* Demonstrated database modernization experience across both commercial and open\-source engines (SQL Server / Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL options).
* Experience designing or selling solutions involving hybrid networking, secure connectivity, or network performance optimization in enterprise environments.
* Advanced understanding of Azure services, including security, compliance, and hybrid cloud scenarios.
* Ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders to design and deploy scalable, secure cloud solutions.

  

  

  

Digital Solution Engineering IC4 \- The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 60,300\.00 \- € 102,600\.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.


Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate\-pay/ireland\-corporate\-pay.html

**Vil du bygge moderne finansløsninger med C\#, Azure og AI i et av Norges ledende finanskonsern?**
===================================================================================================

  

Data og kunstig intelligens er et strategisk satsningsområde i Storebrand. Vi har ambisjon om å bli et enda mer datadrevet konsern, hvor data og teknologi brukes til å skape bedre beslutninger, smartere prosesser og gode kundeopplevelser.  



  

Som fullstack\-utvikler blir du en del av CFO IT, et fagmiljø med ansvar for utvikling av systemer og modeller innen blant annet Solvens II og IFRS 17\. Teamet utvikler skreddersydde løsninger for CFO\-området og samarbeider tett med både forretningsmiljøer og andre teknologiteam på tvers av konsernet.  



  

Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne teknologi, stor faglig bredde og spennende problemstillinger i skjæringspunktet mellom finans, data og programvareutvikling. Du får muligheten til å påvirke både løsninger, arbeidsmetoder og teknologivalg i et miljø som er opptatt av kontinuerlig forbedring og læring.  



**Arbeidsoppgaver**

* Delta i hele programvareutviklingssyklusen, fra design og utvikling til drift og videreutvikling
* Utvikle og vedlikeholde skreddersydde løsninger for CFO\-området
* Modernisere plattformer og bidra til forbedring av arbeidsprosesser og utviklingsmetodikk
* Utforske og ta i bruk nye AI\-verktøy og teknologier i utviklingsarbeidet
* Bidra med teknisk sparring og støtte til andre utviklere

Samarbeide tett med fagområder i CFO for å utvikle løsninger som skaper verdi for brukerne  

* 

**Hvem ser vi etter?**

Vi ser etter deg som har minst tre års erfaring med programvareutvikling og god forståelse for hele utviklingsløpet fra idé til produksjon. Du har erfaring med C\#, og det er en fordel om du også har jobbet med Azure, GitHub og SQL. Interesse for moderne teknologi, skyplattformer og AI\-verktøy er viktig for å lykkes i rollen. Erfaring fra finansbransjen er ikke et krav.  



**Personlige egenskaper**

Du er nysgjerrig, løsningsorientert og opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet ditt. Du trives med å samarbeide med andre, deler gjerne kunnskap og motiveres av å bidra til både teamets og organisasjonens utvikling. Samtidig evner du å jobbe selvstendig, ta initiativ og drive oppgaver fremover. Du liker å lære nye ting, utfordre etablerte løsninger og utforske ny teknologi.  



**Vår kultur**

Hos oss blir du en del av et miljø med høy faglig kompetanse, stort engasjement og kort vei fra idé til handling. Du får jobbe med spennende utfordringer, moderne teknologi og kolleger som deler kunnskap og løfter hverandre.  



  

Vi tror de beste løsningene skapes gjennom samarbeid, nysgjerrighet og vilje til å lære. Derfor får du stor variasjon i oppgaver, gode utviklingsmuligheter og muligheten til å utforske ny teknologi og AI i praksis.  



  

Har du driv, lærelyst og interesse for teknologi, gir vi deg verktøyene og støtten du trenger for å lykkes.  



**Hvorfor velge Storebrand?**

Hos oss får du rom til å ta plass, bli hørt og utvikle deg i et konsern med mange muligheter. Vi er stolte av kulturen vår, drivkraften vår og den felles retningen vi jobber mot: En fremtid å glede seg til.  



  

Vi tror på verdien av ulike perspektiver og bakgrunner, og jobber aktivt for et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø. Det blir lagt merke til: I 2025 rangerte Equileap Storebrand som nummer én i Norge og blant de tre beste selskapene i verden på likestilling. I 2026 vant vi ODA Champions.  



  

Som fremtidsoptimister tenker vi langsiktig og investerer i løsninger som styrker oss og samfunnet rundt oss. Det er én grunn til at vi er ett av to norske selskaper i Dow Jones Best\-in\-Class World Index.  



  

Hos oss på Lysaker jobber du sentralt, med gode kollektivmuligheter, sykkelparkering og garderober. Du får helseforsikring, tilgang til kiropraktor og fysioterapeut på kontoret, og gode treningsmuligheter i Storebrand Arena. I tillegg tilbyr vi en meget god pensjonsordning, gunstige forsikringer og boliglån med subsidiert rente.  



  

**Søknadsfrist: 15\. oktober**

  

**Kontaktperson:** Anders Bechet, Leder CFO IT
  

**Telefon:** \+47 903 66 498
  

**E\-post:** anders.bechet@storebrand.no  



  

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!  



  

Å søke jobb i Storebrand skal være enkelt. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive et søknadsbrev. Vi ønsker kun din CV og svar på noen få spørsmål i søknadsprosessen.


Vi tror på at mangfold styrker oss, og ønsker alle kvalifiserte søkere uansett bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen. Trenger du tilpasninger i søknadsprosessen? Ikke nøl med å gi oss beskjed – slik at vi sammen kan finne en løsning som fungerer for deg.


*Storebrand samarbeider med Semac for bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen. I forbindelse med bakgrunnssjekk må politiattest fremlegges for stillinger som krever autorisasjon og/eller godkjenning av egnethet.*

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Event Processing & Intelligence Services (C# / Python)
jobs.description:
Location: On\-site with possibility to work remote


Team: Data \& AI


Seniority: Mid\-Level to Senior

**About the Platform**


Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission\-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI\-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C\#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event\-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.


You will work closely with colleagues in the Data \& AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.


This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of event\-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.


We are looking for a self\-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge\-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.


Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

**What You Will Do**

**Event Processing \& Pipelines**

* Build event\-driven pipelines in C\# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query
* Design processing that is correct under real\-world conditions: retries, out\-of\-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at\-least\-once semantics
* Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append\-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems
* Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate
**Detection \& Enrichment Services**

* Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring
* Keep the signal\-to\-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty
* Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release
* Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product
**APIs \& Integration**

* Design and build the C\# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services
* Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)
* Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers
* Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes
**Running What We Build**

* Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer
* Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down
* Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own
**What You Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Solid experience with C\#/.NET backend development
* Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python\-first engineer, but you should be productive in it
* Strong experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes
* Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment
* Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event\-driven interfaces)
* Experience with cloud\-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C\#/.NET production environment
* Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution
* Experience building multi\-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge
* Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)
* Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability
**Nice to Have**

**Experience with any of the following is a plus:**


Platform and engineering breadth

* Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)
* Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)
* Kubernetes and container\-based deployments (Docker, AKS)
* Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)
* Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
* Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)
* Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
* Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns
* Append\-only / immutable data stores and time\-series databases
**Domain**

* Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)
* Rules engines or customer\-configurable detection logic
* Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission\-critical / regulated environments
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443
**Machine learning and data science**

* Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning
* MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)
* Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies
* Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data
* Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control
**Why Join Us**


You will be joining an ambitious and fast\-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. If you want to be part of building something meaningful with a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship, you will feel at home here.

**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Role Summary


We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to help build next\-generation cybersecurity AI products for enterprise security teams.


This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an engineer who combines strong AI engineering capability, practical software development skills, and a strong interest in cybersecurity. You will report to the Director, Cybersecurity AI Product and work as part of a newly formed product development team focused on building and operating agentic solutions that help users investigate threats, triage alerts, automate security workflows, analyze vulnerabilities, and make better security decisions.


The ideal candidate is AI\-native, product\-minded, proactive, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You should be able to learn quickly, experiment with new AI technologies, build reliable product features, and translate customer problems into practical AI\-driven solutions.


This role requires hands\-on experience with LLM applications, agentic AI systems, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool orchestration, context management, model evaluation, cloud\-native software engineering, APIs, and secure software development. Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, security operations, cloud security, or threat intelligence is strongly preferred.

* Develop Production\-Grade Software
* Continuously Learn, Research and Evaluate Emerging AI technologies

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other related fields.
* 2\+ years of professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical roles.
* 1\+ years of hands\-on experience building AI/ML, LLM\-based, automation, data\-driven, or intelligent software systems.


AI Engineering:

	+ Vector databases
	+ Knowledge graphs

* Experience using commercial or open\-source AI models and APIs.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools in everyday work for coding, debugging, research, documentation, testing, or productivity improvement.


Software Engineering:

* Strong programming ability in one or more languages such as:
	+ Python
	+ TypeScript / Node.js
	+ Go
	+ Java
	+ C\#
	+ Rust
* Experience building backend services, APIs, data pipelines, integrations, or cloud\-native applications.
* Familiarity with web applications, distributed systems, databases, CI/CD pipelines, logging, monitoring, and automated testing.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, secure, and production\-ready code.
* Experience participating in design reviews, code reviews, and production troubleshooting.


Cloud and Infrastructure:

Preferred Qualifications:
