jobs.title: Assistance Sales Manager( Engineering/Technical)
jobs.description:
\#\#\# Assistant Sales Manager — Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

\#\#\#\# Role Summary
  
  

Responsible for supporting the Sales Manager in driving revenue, managing key accounts, coordinating between sales and service teams, and supervising sales staff. The Assistant Sales Manager helps convert leads, maintain customer relationships, prepare commercial proposals, and ensure sales targets and service commitments are met.
  
  

\#\#\# Core Responsibilities
  
  

* \*\*Sales Execution: \*\* Support the Sales Manager in achieving monthly and annual sales targets; follow up on leads, prepare quotations, and close deals.
* \*\*Account Management: \*\* Maintain relationships with key customers; act as primary contact for assigned accounts; ensure contract terms and SLAs are met.
* \*\*Sales Planning \& Reporting: \*\* Assist in sales forecasting, pipeline management, and preparing weekly/monthly sales reports and dashboards.
* \*\*Proposal \& Contract Support: \*\* Draft and review commercial proposals, service agreements, and renewal documents; coordinate internal approvals.
* \*\*Cross‑Functional Coordination: \*\* Work closely with Service, Operations, and Finance to ensure smooth handover of projects, timely invoicing, and fulfilment of service obligations.
* \*\*Pricing \& Negotiation: \*\* Support pricing strategy, discount approvals, and commercial negotiations within delegated authority.
* \*\*Customer Visits \& Presentations: \*\* Conduct site visits, product demonstrations, and technical briefings with customers and prospects.
* \*\*Sales Team Supervision: \*\* Coach and mentor junior sales staff; assign leads, monitor performance, and ensure accurate CRM updates.
* \*\*Market Intelligence: \*\* Gather competitor and market information; identify upsell/cross‑sell opportunities and feed insights into product and pricing decisions.
* \*\*Customer Experience: \*\* Ensure high customer satisfaction by resolving escalations, coordinating rapid responses, and following up on service outcomes.


\-\-\-
  
  

\#\#\#\# People Management \& Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Team Development: \*\* Train and develop sales executives on product knowledge, sales techniques, and CRM usage.
* \*\*Performance Management: \*\* Set clear KPIs, conduct regular reviews, and implement corrective actions to improve team performance.
* \*\*Culture \& Conduct: \*\* Promote professional conduct, punctuality, and accurate documentation to minimise human errors.


\-\-\-
  
  

\#\#\#\# SOPs, Contracts \& Compliance
  
  

* \*\*SOP Enforcement: \*\* Ensure sales and handover processes follow documented SOPs; identify gaps and propose improvements.
* \*\*Contract Renewals: \*\* Lead annual contract renewal process for assigned accounts; prepare renewal proposals and negotiate terms.
* \*\*Documentation: \*\* Maintain accurate records of quotations, contracts, approvals, and customer communications.
* \*\*Risk \& Compliance: \*\* Ensure all commercial activities comply with company policy, legal requirements, and industry standards.


\-\-\-
  
  

\#\#\#\# KPIs \& Success Metrics
  
  

* \*\*Revenue attainment\*\* (monthly / quarterly / annual)
* \*\*Pipeline conversion rate\*\* and average deal size
* \*\*Contract renewal rate\*\* and churn reduction
* \*\*Customer satisfaction score (CSAT)\*\* or Net Promoter Score (NPS) for managed accounts
* \*\*Average response time\*\* for customer enquiries and escalations
* \*\*Accuracy of CRM records\*\* and reduction in documentation errors
* \*\*Team performance metrics\*\* (quota attainment, lead follow‑up rate)


\-\-\-
  
  

\#\#\#\# Required Skills \& Experience
  
  

* \*\*Commercial acumen: \*\* Strong pricing, negotiation, and contract management skills.
* \*\*Leadership: \*\* Ability to coach, motivate, and hold a small sales team accountable for results.
* \*\*Analytical: \*\* Comfortable with CRM analytics and sales forecasting.
* \*\*Execution: \*\* Strong bias for action; closes deals and removes blockers.
* \*\*Collaboration: \*\* Works seamlessly with Service, Operations, and Finance to protect margins.
* \*\*Tools: \*\* Proficient with CRM (e.g., Salesforce), MS Excel, and reporting dashboards.
* \*\*Experience: \*\* 3–6 years in B2B sales or service sales; prior supervisory experience preferred.
* \*\*Communication: \*\* Clear written and verbal communication; confident presenter.
* \*\*Coordination: \*\* Proven ability to work cross‑functionally with operations and service teams.
* \*\*Leadership: \*\* Coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution skills.
* \*\*Organisational: \*\* Strong planning, time management, and attention to detail.
* \*\*Technical aptitude: \*\* Comfortable with product specifications, basic technical drawings, or service workflows.
* \*\*Tools: \*\* Proficient with CRM systems, MS Office, and basic reporting tools.

jobs.description:
ATS Singapore is currently seeking a suitable candidate to ‘Support \& Deliver’ Industrial automation projects to leading manufacturers in Singapore, with a specific focus on project delivery and operational support.
  
  

The Position
  
  

Initially this role will support the current systems deployed across manufacturing \& assembly sites in Singapore. You will support shopfloor software as well as develop supporting documentation governed by quality gates through a defined project lifecycle. On completion of each project you will serve as part of a support group maintaining deployed systems to ensure their operability within the production environment.
  
  

The Person
  
  

The right candidate has up to 2\-7 years’ experience in a similar support role. Knowledge of Manufacturing Processes \& Automation would also be advantageous in this role. An ability to self\-manage the support of shopfloor IT projects as per the customer requirements and support is critical to this position. The candidate should be an good communicator and be able to present root causes clearly and effectively both internally and externally.
  
  

Any previous knowledge of supporting and delivering factory shop floor applications, collection of OEM machine tools data, SCADA/PLC integration and MES systems would be greatly beneficial.
  
  

Candidates should be motivated and capable of the development and application of skills in new and existing technologies. This will be a customer facing role reporting to a senior customer management level and a multi\-vendor environment. Good interpersonal skills and able to interface with all levels, internally and externally, in a professional and responsive manner.
  
  

A willingness to travel is essential in this position.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

* Support and delivery of Shop\-Floor IT projects including shopfloor applications including PLC, preferable SCADA based development, .NET applications and other Shopfloor I.T.
* Under direction of the Operations Manager deliver timely and SLA bounded responses to customer calls, dealing with issues through a formal support management process to formal support closure.
* Under the guidance of the Operations Manager, deliver projects through the full Lifecycle from detailed planning to customer/support acceptance.
* Interface with all levels of customer stakeholders for detailed planning and delivery of projects \& support.
* Maintain detailed site records all to provide support colleagues with correct \& up to date on the supported site status.


Technical Key Skills Required Include
  
  

* Experience with manufacturing / automation applications
* I.T Integration to Machine tools and data collection
* Support process knowledge
* IT delivery \& commissioning experience

Manufacturing environment experience, Support skills, IT system and experience with Manufacturing applications, .NET/scada applications, degitilisation knowledge
  
  

Further Key Skills
  
  

* Customer facing experience

* English speaking

Become part of a dynamic, successful team designing, delivering \& supporting industrial IT solutions to improve our customers’ performance. A benefits package commensurate with the role will be offered to the right candidate.

jobs.title: IT Operations Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**About the role**
------------------

The ICT Operations Support Engineer is responsible for the day\-to\-day administration and operational support of the client's ICT environment. The role focuses on service request management, IT administration, vendor coordination, user support, and operational governance to ensure ICT services are delivered effectively, securely, and in compliance with Whole\-of\-Government (WOG) standards.

  

A key responsibility of this role is to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of ICT service requests, ensuring requests are accurately raised, tracked, fulfilled, and verified before closure.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**ICT Operations \& Service Request Management**

* Raise, track, and manage ICT service requests, incidents, and operational support activities.
* Coordinate with government agencies, managed service providers, and vendors to fulfil requests within agreed SLAs.
* Review and validate service request submissions, approvals, and fulfilment evidence.
* Monitor request backlog, follow up on outstanding requests, and escalate service delivery issues where necessary.
* Maintain accurate records and audit trails for operational activities.
  

**IT Administration \& User Support**

* Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, and Intune.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and access management processes.
* Manage user accounts, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, licenses, and security groups.
* Coordinate endpoint provisioning, software installation, and workplace technology support.
  

**Vendor \& Service Delivery Management**

* Act as the liaison between the client and ICT service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and KPIs.
* Review service reports and validate completed work before acceptance.
* Participate in operational and service review meetings.
  

**Governance, Security \& Compliance**

* Support ICT governance, audit, risk management, and cybersecurity activities.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and support compliance exercises.
* Ensure ICT processes and documentation remain current and audit\-ready.
  

**Asset \& Operations Support**

* Maintain ICT asset inventory and software license records.
* Support asset verification, refresh, replacement, and disposal activities.
* Assist in incident management, problem management, and operational reporting.
**Requirements**
----------------

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  

**Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT operations, IT administration, service management, or infrastructure support.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and workplace technologies.
* Experience working with vendors and managed service providers.
* Familiarity with IT service management processes and tools.
  

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working within the Singapore Government ICT environment.
* Familiarity with WOG ICT processes, governance, and support models.
* Experience using Government ICT support portals such as:
* + ITSM Portal
	+ SGMail Administration Portal
	+ EUSS Portal
* Experience supporting user provisioning, access management, email administration, and workplace technology services.
  

**Key Competencies**

* IT Administration
* Service Request Management
* Vendor Coordination
* Customer Service Excellence
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Operational Governance and Compliance
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**

  

Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.

  

As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.

  

**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.

  

**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020 **.**

  

Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.

  

Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.


Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


Sopra Steria is a listed European technology leader specializing in Consulting, Digital Services, and Software. With over 51,000 employees worldwide across Europe, North America and Asia, the Group supports organizations in driving their digital transformation and delivering sustainable business value.  

  

In Asia Pacific, Singapore serves as the regional headquarter for Sopra Steria’s Infrastructure, Cloud and Cybersecurity services.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Description:**


For this project, we are forming a team of 6 (including 1 team lead) to assist in a huge government project to perform the following scope of works:

* Security Risk Assessment
* Security Policies, Standards, Guidelines, And Procedures Review
* Security Design
* Application Security
* Vulnerability assessment and
* System Security Acceptance Testing
* Cloud Security


The selected candidate will be working collaboratively within the team to fulfil the project requirements. As such, there is no expectation for one individual to possess all skill sets in the 6 domains.


As an expert in **Application Security**, your role will focus on providing expert advice, conducting security assessments, and helping government teams build security into every stage of their software development lifecycle.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform comprehensive risk assessments of development environments, DevOps workflows, and CI/CD processes.
* Perform security assessments, threat modelling, and code reviews to identify vulnerabilities in applications.
* Review and recommend improvements in areas such as identity and access management, network security, secure SDLC practices, source code management, cryptographic key handling, and data protection.
* Guide application teams on adopting secure development practices and integrating security tools such as SAST, DAST, and VAPT into their workflows.
* Review existing CI/CD pipelines from a security perspective and provide expert recommendations to align with DevSecOps principles.
* Mentor and advise internal teams on secure coding practices across various platforms and languages (e.g., JavaScript, Node.js, Java, C\#, Python, etc.).
* Develop and maintain secure coding guidelines and security standards.
* Collaborate with development teams to remediate security issues and provide guidance on secure coding practices.

------------------

* At least 3 years of experience in application security or software development with security focus.
* Strong experience in DevSecOps with a solid foundation in cybersecurity and risk assessment.
* Hands\-on knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) principles and tools.
* Familiarity with integrating security testing tools and practices within CI/CD environments.
* Experience with secure coding and vulnerability assessments across common web and mobile technologies.
* Ability to work with and guide development teams without being directly involved in implementation.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex security requirements into practical advice
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* **Work\-life balance**: Hybrid working mode, 18 days of Annual leave
* **Health \& insurance:** Comprehensive coverage including General Practitioner, hospitalization, dental, and optical


**•Performance incentives:** Annual bonus based on individual performance  

**•Learning \& development**: Training programs, certification opportunities, and training incentives to support career growth  

**•Team culture:** Regular team\-building activities and social events

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer
jobs.description:
Your code will travel with ambulance crews on shift, on the devices they carry. Join our Prague\-based team and help emergency services reach people faster.


We build software that manages and optimizes patient transport logistics, so that response times for emergency cases keep coming down. Crews use it in the field across Europe, North and South America, and Australia. In the U.S. alone, we handle 20% of all medical transports.


*This hybrid role requires working from the office 2\-3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the Czech Republic and available for regular in\-office collaboration in Prague.*


*Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship; candidates must have full authorization to work in the Czech Republic.*


**What you will work on**


You will start in our existing native iOS application, keeping it stable and dependable for the crews who rely on it every day. That work is also the quickest way to learn the domain. From there, you will move into our Flutter development, which is where our cross\-platform work is heading.


**How we work with AI**


AI coding tools are central to how we work, and we use them well past autocomplete: long sessions, agent loops, and workflows we keep reshaping as the tools change. We are looking for someone who wants to push those boundaries further while staying behind the wheel. Whoever or whatever writes the first draft, the result is yours once it ships.


**Who You Are – The Essentials**


* Genuine interest in mobile development and in the people who use what you build
* Solid Flutter and Dart skills
* Native iOS experience, including comfort working in an established codebase
* Critical thinking and an open mind – you ask why, and you update your view when the evidence points elsewhere
* Willingness to pick up new, promising technologies and approaches
* Proficiency in English, spoken and written

**Who You Are – The Desirables**


* Experience with Android development
* Knowledge of TypeScript or .NET
* Czech at a conversational level
* Living close enough to Prague to be in the office regularly – we are a small team, and our best ideas come from brainstorming together there
* A good sense of humor and a positive outlook

**Benefits \& Perks:**


* 25 days of paid annual vacation
* 5 wellbeing days – fully paid sick days
* Floating holidays – paid days to use for important personal events (the number may vary each year)
* 3 months of fully paid maternity or paternity leave
* 1 paid volunteering day
* 10 fully paid days for loss and grief
* Meal Allowance
* Competitive Salary: along with a comprehensive benefits package.
* Health and Wellness program based on point\-earning system that are exchanged for e\-voucher
* Ergonomic Workspace: Electrically adjustable desks, comfortable chairs, laptop, phone, and internet.
* Hybrid Workforce: Flexible options to perform your role from our centrally located office, convenient to shopping and restaurants, or from home as needed.
* Office Amenities: Convenient safe bike\-parking and onsite shower facilities, catering to those who prefer sustainable commuting options.
* Career Development \& Training: Benefit from career development programs, mentorship opportunities, training sessions, and paths for advancement.
* Inclusive Workplace: a diverse, equitable, and inclusive global workplace where all people feel supported, and creativity and new ideas are encouraged.
* Employee Referral Bonus Program: Earn bonuses for referring talented individuals to join our team.

**About ESO**


ESO is a fast\-paced, growing data, technology, and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user\-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our Czech Republic, Denmark, Canada, UK, the US and Cista Rica offices.


Are you ready to Make a Difference? At ESO, we believe in bringing your true self to work every single day. If you don’t match all the qualifications on the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway! We are looking for passionate, innovative, and authentic people to help drive our mission.


All offers are contingent upon a successful background check.


*ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political affiliation or opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status; veteran status; or other non\-merit factor.*


Applicant Privacy Notice –

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun \- leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation \- for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


TA Team Lead \- Czechia \& Slovakia### 

**Move the World as an Electrical Design Engineer with ABB**
------------------------------------------------------------


Would you like to be part of digital development and contribute to innovations in engineering documentation? Are you interested in working with databases and CAD tools, and looking for a meaningful role within a supportive and highly skilled team? We are looking for a new colleague to join us. We will provide comprehensive onboarding, continuous support, and the opportunity to work on projects with an international reach.

**What you can expect from us:**
--------------------------------

* Working with ePlan and SAP systems
* Preparing master data and developing logical rules for generating engineering drawings
* Collaborating with colleagues across multiple departments
* Supporting users of EPLAN and its extensions, both locally and within international teams
* Participating in innovative projects and developing new solutions

**What we are looking for:**
----------------------------

* Secondary school or university degree in Electrical Engineering (also open to graduates with experience in C\+\+ or C\# programming), Industrial Automation, or Measurement and Control Engineering
* Ability to read and create technical documentation
* Experience with EPLAN Electric P8 is an advantage
* Knowledge of scripting or logical expressions is an advantage
* English language skills at least at B1 level
* Willingness to learn and continuously develop
* Strong attention to detail
* Independent and analytical approach to tasks
* Team spirit, communication skills, and enthusiasm for learning new things
* Category B driving license is an advantage

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Annual financial bonus
* Flexible working hours
* Hybrid work / Home Office option
* Meal allowance or subsidized meals in the company canteen (depending on location)
* 5 weeks of vacation
* Career growth opportunities (development within ABB locations worldwide)
* Offices in the center of Plzeň (easy access by train, bus, and tram)
* Language courses, both group and individual
* Mobile phone and attractive corporate tariff for you and up to five family members
* Paid leave for major life events (wedding, childbirth, funeral, blood donation, relocation)
* Company events (Christmas party, Family Day, Career Days, team\-building activities, and more)
* MultiSport card for sports and leisure activities
* Contribution to a flexible benefits portal (2%–3%)
* Discounts from our partners (vehicle purchases, train travel, holidays, and more)

**More About Us**

ABB's Process Automation business empowers customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures while helping them achieve better results more efficiently and sustainably.


We provide a broad portfolio of automation, electrification, and digitalization solutions for process, hybrid, and marine industries, including integrated control systems, industry\-specific software, as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

**Join Us**
-----------


Become part of a team where progress is created, industries are transformed, and your work helps shape the world.


Things are truly moving here: technology, industry, and the world around us. And you can be part of it.

**Create with us what gives the world direction.**

**\#RunWithABB**


A future opportunity


This role is part of our talent pipeline, which means it’s not currently open, but we’re always looking for curious minds, bold thinkers, and people who want to make an impact.


Click Apply to express your interest and be considered for future opportunities that match your experience and aspirations.


At ABB, we welcome people from all backgrounds and believe that diverse perspectives help us build a cleaner, smarter future.


Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about how we help run what runs the world.

### **Description \& Requirements**

Job Description
**Company Overview**


AESC is a global leader in lithium‑ion and LFP battery technology, with a fast‑growing footprint across Japan, the UK, France, China, and the USA—now expanding in Spain with a €1‑billion gigafactory in Extremadura that will create up to 900 direct jobs in phase one. The Spanish facility is designed as the first net‑zero industrial park gigafactory in the country, aligning with AESC’s mission to pioneer sustainable battery manufacturing.

 **Role Purpose**


The **Cost Engineer** will own the cost control of the construction of AESC’s battery gigafactory in Navalmoral de la Mata, acting on behalf of AESC as owner/end\-user. The role will **prepare and maintain project estimates and budgets, define and review quantities for civil works and MEP packages, monitor actual cost against budget and forecast, and assess the economic impact of changes and risks**. Working closely with the Commercial Manager, the Global Infrastructure \& Construction (GIC) team, Chinese project/engineering teams, EPC contractors and consultants, the position will provide management with accurate and timely cost information to support decision\-making.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare cost estimates, budgets and cost analyses for civil works and MEP systems, and review preliminary and official budgets and reference prices.
* Define and review quantities, measurements and Bills of Quantities (BoQ) with engineering firms and consultants, to be used for tendering and cost control.
* Manage the full project cost control cycle: cost planning, monitoring, variance analysis and forecasting (actual vs. budget, committed cost, forecast at completion).
* Prepare monthly cost reports and dashboards for management, highlighting deviations, trends and risks.
* Verify executed quantities and progress on site as the basis for certifications and payments to contractors and suppliers.
* Assess the cost and budget impact of scope changes, design modifications and claims, providing the technical\-economic basis to the Commercial Manager.
* Identify economic risks early, quantify exposure and propose the required contingency.
* Analyse market prices for materials, equipment, labour rates and productivity, using local benchmarks.
* Support tender processes with cost input: bid comparison, price analysis and consistency between budget, contracts and procurement.
* Build and maintain the project cost database for benchmarking, and support the final cost close\-out of the project.
  

Led by a diverse and experienced management team, **AESC employs more than 14,000 professionals worldwide**. The company combines state\-of\-the\-art technology, Japanese craftsmanship, and a strong track record in safety to deliver advanced battery solutions. AESC offers a comprehensive portfolio across various cathode chemistries and form factors, including LFP, NCM/MCA, and pouch, cylindrical, and prismatic cell formats.

  

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.

  

Don't you want to be part of this cutting\-edge and revolutionary company?

  

\#LI\-SD1


Requirements / Required skills
* Cost Control
* Cost Engineering
* Cost Management
* Cost Planning
* Cost Reporting
* Cost benchmarking
* Cost Analysis
* Cost Estimation


Qualifications
**Desired Requirements**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Building Engineering, Engineering Cost/Quantity Surveying or a related field.
* At least 6 years of experience in cost engineering, cost control, project controls or quantity surveying on construction, infrastructure or industrial/manufacturing projects.
* Proven experience on construction projects in Spain, with knowledge of the Spanish construction market and prices.
* Solid experience in cost estimation, budgeting, forecasting and cost reporting for civil works and MEP.
* Experience measuring quantities, preparing BoQs and validating certifications.
* Experience working with EPC contractors on large\-scale projects; experience on the owner/end\-user side is highly valued.
* Ideally, experience in gigafactories, battery plants, data centres, pharma, chemical or other process facilities, and in fast\-track projects.
* Advanced Excel and cost management software (e.g., Presto, Arquímedes, CostX or similar); SAP knowledge. Power BI and AutoCAD are desirable.
* Language Skills: Spanish – native or proficiency (mandatory); English – upper\-intermediate or above; Chinese – a plus.
* Based in Navalmoral de la Mata or within approximately 45 minutes by car, or willing to relocate.
* Detail\-oriented, analytical and resolutive, able to work with multiple stakeholders in an international and multicultural environment.

jobs.title: Application Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**


At Telio, we build technology that reconnects people.  

Our systems enable hundreds of thousands of inmates to stay connected with their families and loved ones. We believe correctional facilities should not only serve as punishment, but also as an opportunity for rehabilitation and a second chance. Through secure communication technology, digital services, and modern software platforms, we elevate the professional and human standards of correctional institutions and other regulated environments (e.g., clinics and state institutions).  

This is a mission\-critical internal product environment where reliability, security, and engineering excellence directly impact real lives.  

We are looking for a skilled **Application Reliability** **Engineer** to support the reliability, monitoring, and automation of business\-critical applications across hybrid Azure and on\-premises environments.  

You will work closely with development, IT operations, and infrastructure teams to detect issues early, improve observability, reduce alert noise, support incident resolution, and prevent recurring problems through automation and a reliability\-first mindset.#### **Your profile**

**Duties and responsibilities**

* Build and maintain monitoring, observability, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and automation.
* Support incident handling, root cause analysis, and long\-term reliability improvements.
* Operate and improve applications and infrastructure in Microsoft Azure, on\-premises, Kubernetes, and GitOps\-based environments.
* Collaborate with development, IT, and infrastructure teams to reduce manual work and improve service stability.

#### **Required Qualifications, Experience \& Competencies**

### **Professional Experience \& Skills**

* 3\+ years’ experience in system operations, application support, or site reliability engineering.
* Experience with Linux and Windows servers, scripting, monitoring or observability tools, and incident management.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Kubernetes, container orchestration, GitOps practices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Basic understanding of .NET/C\#, web applications, web services, relational databases, and infrastructure operations.
* Analytical mindset, strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and communicational level English.
* Advantage: Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, SLI/SLO concepts, escalation tooling, container security, networking fundamentals, REST/SOAP APIs, or message queues.

#### **Why us?**

**We are offering*** Professional challenges, inspiring, diverse tasks
* Learning path on new technologies
* Multiculture environment
* Flexible working hours and home office days (2 days/week)
* Relaxed atmosphere, steady, supportive international team
* Easily accessible modern office with good infrastructure

#### **About us**


Telio is a medium\-sized, internationally active, rapidly growing company in the field of telecommunications and IT services in the prison sector. As the European market leader, we have been providing communications solutions for prisons and their inmates worldwide for over 25 years. With more than 300 employees, we are active in 23 countries and develop, install and operate communication and media systems that make an important contribution to resocialization in prisons as well as in correctional facilities.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, EA, the role involves full\-stack development using React and .NET Core APIs, cloud\-native data management with SQL Azure and Azure Cosmos DB, and deployment and operations on Microsoft Azure infrastructure.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain web applications using React (frontend) and .NET Core API (backend), ensuring high performance and scalability.
* Build and maintain data models, schemas, and stored procedures in SQL Azure; design and manage collections in Azure Cosmos DB.
* Design and implement integrations between internal systems and third\-party platforms using REST APIs, Azure Service Bus, and Azure API Management.
* Deploy, configure, and manage application infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, etc.).
* Contribute to architecture reviews and technical design decisions; participate in sprint planning and agile ceremonies.
* Monitor application performance, investigate and resolve production issues, and implement preventive improvements.
* Maintain and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps; follow DevOps and Infrastructure\-as\-Code best practices.
* Apply security best practices across all application layers including authentication, authorization, and data protection.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, design, operations, and vendors to deliver high\-quality solutions.

**Job\-Specific Competencies**

* Full\-Stack Development – Proficiency in React and .NET Core for building responsive, scalable enterprise applications.
* Cloud Engineering – Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Data Management – Experience with relational (SQL Azure) and NoSQL (Cosmos DB) databases in production environments.
* Integration Design – Ability to design and implement system integrations using REST APIs, messaging, and event\-driven patterns.
* DevOps Practices – Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Bicep/ARM templates).
* Security Awareness – Understanding of cloud security principles, identity management (Azure AD/Entra ID), and secure coding practices.

  

**Qualifications** **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3–5 years of software development experience in a professional environment.
* Proven hands\-on experience with React and .NET Core API development.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Experience working with SQL Azure (relational) and Azure Cosmos DB (NoSQL) in production systems.
* Experience with RESTful API design, system integration patterns, and enterprise application development.
* Microsoft Azure certification (e.g., AZ\-204 Developer Associate or AZ\-900\) preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Deep knowledge of React component architecture, hooks, and state management (Redux / Context API).
* Strong knowledge of .NET Core, C\#, and RESTful API design principles including authentication (OAuth 2\.0, Azure AD/Entra ID).
* Knowledge of Azure PaaS services: App Services, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
* Understanding of database design, query optimization, and data modeling in both SQL Azure and Cosmos DB.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, event\-driven design, and enterprise integration patterns
* Proficient in React, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Proficient in C\# and .NET Core, including Entity Framework Core and middleware patterns.
* Skilled in Azure portal, Azure DevOps, and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Bicep / ARM templates).
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, testable code and conduct meaningful code reviews.
* Strong debugging, root\-cause analysis, and performance\-tuning skills.
* Must have: Experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) for AI\-assisted software development.
* Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional, agile delivery teams and take end\-to\-end ownership of features.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and deliver within sprint timelines.
* Strong communication skills – able to articulate technical decisions clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to adapt quickly to evolving requirements, new Azure services, and emerging technologies.

  

**Additional Information** **Organizational Competencies**  

**Customer Focus** \- People demonstrating this competency understand \& exceed our customers’ needs. They develop trusted, reliable \& collaborative relationships. They are consistently operating to the highest standards of service \& delivery.

**Innovation** \- People demonstrating this competency constantly seek new \& improved ways to deliver our products \& services. They champion engineering \& skills development, and work to create a collaborative and supportive operating environment.

**Integrity** \- People demonstrating this competency are open \& honest in everything they do. They support financially \& environmentally sustainable growth. They make socially responsible decisions and treat their stakeholders with respect.

**Be Bold** \- People demonstrating this competency are thorough in analyses \& decision\-making. They are courageous in expanding existing markets \& developing new ones. They confidently pursue appropriate financial returns and are forward\-thinking and ambitious.

**Sustainability**\- People demonstrating this competency are constantly seeking to create positive impact in the communities we serve.

**Our Vision**  

IHS is committed to improving the quality and availability of telecommunications infrastructure, the lifeline for an increasingly connected world. We are dedicated to helping create a sustainable future for the communities in which we operate, and our sustainable strategy is structured around four pillars: ethics and governance, environment and climate change, education and economic growth, and our people and communities.

new_jobs.title: 3D Platform Engineer | Range Operations
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description** **Hej 3D Platform Engineer,**

**Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?**


With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

 **Your new job**


You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.


We’re looking for a 3D Platform Engineer to build the shared capabilities behind IKEA’s next generation of 3D digital planning and product experiences. You will transform complex CAD and PLM product data into reliable, scalable 3D assets and services—covering tessellation, mesh optimization, LOD generation, and preservation of visual and geometric fidelity. Your work will make high\-quality 3D product data easier to use across customer\-facing planning solutions, content production, and product development. On a typical week, you will:

* Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle\-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C\#, C\+\+, and Python.
* Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well\-defined development briefs.
* Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product\-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
* Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
* Build automated CAD\-to\-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
* Develop and validate mesh\-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high\-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
* Benchmark and integrate commercial and open\-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud\-based 3D processing services.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**


As a 3D Platform Engineer, you combine strong software engineering with practical knowledge of 3D data, pipelines, and runtime needs. You can work across the full flow—from CAD and PLM sources to optimized assets and scalable services. You should also bring:

* A strong understanding of computer graphics, real\-time and offline rendering, and production\-ready 3D asset pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
* Knowledge of product\-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
* Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
* A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business\-critical services in an agile environment.
* A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong C\+\+ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third\-party libraries.
* Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
* Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.


Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C\+\+, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh\-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all\- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.


It’s a plus if you also bring:

* Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
* Experience with mesh\-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!**


Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.


Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co\-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

 **We welcome your application**


Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 15th of October.


This is a full\-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager taco.van.der.maden1@inter.ikea.com.


At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.


If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co\-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co\-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*
